title: Nighwalker Leap Sand
description:
Description:

This macro was created specifically for the Nightshade characters, ensuring the smooth application of two skills at once. It combines a jump with a «Dark Jump» (F2) and a «Sand Throw» (F3) in one click, allowing you to instantly move to the target and immediately immobilize it. A short delay of 72 ms between the two skills guarantees the correct execution of both commands without failures.

The macro is especially useful in the following situations:

- **Single Targets**: Quickly activate an attack on isolated players before they have time to react.
- **Objectives on horseback**: Interrupt the escape of players on horseback and force them to join the battle. 

How to use a macro:

- **Bind to a key**: Assign a macro to a key located next to your movement keys (for example, Q, E or the mouse button) for quick and convenient use.
- **Select a goal**: Make sure that the desired goal is selected. Use manual or automatic guidance if necessary.
- **Execute the macro**: Press the assigned key to activate the sequence. You will instantly move to the target with a «Dark Jump» (F2) and immediately stop it with a «Sand Throw» (F3).

Tips for effective use:

- **Optimal Timing**: Make sure you are within reach of the «Dark Jump» before activating the macro.
- **Keep an eye on reloading**: Make sure both skills are ready to use for continued effectiveness.

Why does it work:

A delay of 72 ms is critically important for the «Sand Throw» to correctly follow the «Dark Jump», as too fast activation can lead to a failure in the second skill. By placing this macro next to the movement keys, you will get a smooth and fast start to the attack, which will significantly save time in battle.

Enjoy the satisfaction of getting off to a fast and effective start with just one click!

This macro has been tested on both official and private servers, including projects such as 4Vision, 4Legacy and 4Classic.

How to use:

1. Set the macro to a key that is convenient for you.
2. Tie archer's basic skills to the keys (1, 2, 3, 7) ( Combat Arrow, Normal Attack, Explosive Arrow, Ruthless Shot).

title: Aion_Shot xxna A4techxx
description:
This macro is intended for use by a character of the Shooter class in the game AION. It optimizes the use of the «Sudden Shot» skill, allowing you to release the entire series of skills at once with the hold of a button on the keyboard.

First, you need to install the skills from the «Sudden Shot» series on the skill panel of your character in cell number 3. So the skills will be available for use in this macro.

In order for the macro to work correctly, several steps should be performed:

1. If you already have a macro running, you need to click the «Stop» button to stop it. If the macro has not been started yet, you can proceed to the next step.
2. At the top of the program you will see the names of various settings (window, keys, A4tech, etc.). Click on «A4tech» to open the «AMC Macro Editor» window.
3. In the left part of the «AMC Macro Editor» window, you will see the preset macros for the AION game. Find the macro you need.
4. The window on the right will display all the delays and buttons that are involved in this macro.
5. Find the button you want to replace with another one. Click on it with the left mouse button, and then find the «Delete» button on the far right side of the window and click it. Thus, the previous assigned button will be deleted.
6. Now you can select any other button on the virtual keyboard that you would like to use instead of the remote one. The button in the macro editor can be moved to any sequence to customize it to your liking.
7. After setting up the necessary keys and cycle delays, click the «Apply» button in the lower right corner of the window.
8. Now you can use this macro in the game by holding the new button on the keyboard. Your character will release the entire series of skills from the «Sudden Shot» skill without having to press the button several times.

Please note that this macro is an updated version of the popular macro, which is intended for use on A4tech keyboards. This is due to the fact that the usual macro editor in AION will be removed soon. I hope that this macro will help you improve the efficiency of using your character's skills in the AION game. Good luck on the battlefield!

1. If the macro is already running, you need to stop it. If it has not been started, proceed to the next step.
2. At the top of the program you will see the section «Window», «Keys», «Macros», etc. Select Macros.
3. After selecting «Macros», the «Macro Editor» window opens. In the left part of the window you will see ready macros for the AION game.
4. Find the desired macro and click on it. All delays and assigned buttons for this macro will be displayed in the right part of the window.
5. Select the button you want to change by clicking on it with the left mouse button. Then, in the far right part of the window, find the «Delete» button and click on it. Thus, the previously assigned macro button will be removed.
6. Now you can assign a new button for your macro. Just left-click on any other button on the virtual keyboard. You can change the sequence of buttons in the macro editor.
7. When you have finished configuring the necessary keys and delays, click the «Apply» button in the lower right corner of the window.
8. Then click OK to close the Macro Editor window.
9. You will return to the main menu of the program. Now select the «Keys» section at the top of the program. On the virtual keyboard, select the new button that you have assigned, and select the desired macro from the drop-down menu. Click the «Run» button.
10. Now you can enjoy the game using the new macro.

The macro will help you save time and make the game more comfortable. Have a nice game!

title: AlbionOnline AFK Farm
description:
You can manually set the positions for collecting resources such as ore, hemp, trees and stone in the Albion Online game using the Keyran program.

It is recommended to use the Frameless Screen mode, or set the resolution to 1366×768. Frameless mode provides the best gaming experience.

The first step is to find a group of three or more closely located resources. Next, set the position for each of the objects:

1. Click on the first resource to set its position.
2. Go to the second resource and set a position for it as well.
3. Continue until the functionality for all necessary resources is installed.

You can adjust the delay time depending on the speed of your collection tool. If the tool collects quickly, reduce the delay time; if it is slow, increase it.

To fine-tune the delay, determine how long it takes to fully collect the resource, and add 4 seconds to this value. For example, if the collection takes 5 seconds, then your delay should be 5 + 4 = 9 seconds.

If you collect several types of resources, you can set different delay values for each of them. To add more items to collect, simply copy the first 8 lines of the code. To delete items, delete 8 lines from the top or bottom of the code.

If the Cancel key in your game is not set to «S», you can either change this assignment in the script or delete it. Please note that when deleting, you should increase the delay time by 6 seconds to maintain accuracy.

Thank you for your attention, I hope this information was useful!

Now in the order of action:
1. Use the Obsessive Burst (R) skill to activate enhanced damage.
2. Then, use the Evasion skill (E) to escape from danger or interruption.
3. Start spamming the «Explosive Arrow» (Q) on a cluster of mobs: Q -> Q -> Q.
4. Next, activate the «Caltrops» skill (W) and spam the «Explosive Arrow» (Q) again: Q -> Q -> Q.
5. Use the «Detonator» skill (D) to forcibly detonate all «Explosive Arrows» (Q) on mobs and inflict additional damage.
6. After that, repeat the «Bursting Arrow» spam (Q) : Q -> Q.
7. In case you use Caerleon Cape, activate the Purple Power skill (F) to increase damage and continue spamming Q: Q -> Q.

title: Crossbow Rotation in Avalon
description:
This macro is intended for use on the crossbow in the Albion Online game, both in the Avalon zones and on ordinary worlds. With it, you can inflict maximum damage to mob clusters.

To begin with, it is worth noting that this rotation is written using Carleon's cloak and the Refreshing Sprint skill, which further enhance your power. 

The rotation looks like this:

1. R (Obsessive Burst) - activate a skill to increase your damage.
2. D (Auto Attack) - perform a normal attack to deal basic damage.
3. Q (Burst Arrow) - launch an explosive arrow at the enemy. When using this skill, you also activate the passive skill «Good Preparation», which adds additional explosive damage. This is your main source of damage and should be used as often as possible. Repeat this step 3 times.
4. W (Caltrops) - throw caltrops that damage all enemies in the area of action. 
5. E (Explosive Shot) - blow up the area where caltrops were thrown, causing great damage to enemies.
6. Q (Burst Arrow) - reuse the explosive arrow. Repeat this step 2 more times.
7. F (Frost Shot) - launch an ice ball that freezes enemies for a while and causes damage to them.
8. W (Caltrops) - drop caltrops again to prepare for the next rotation.
9. Q (Burst Arrow) - reuse the explosive arrow. Repeat this step 2 more times.

It is important to note that if your rotation is set to achieve low DPS (damage per second), you can use additional Burst Arrow shots, since Skill E must explode before the mobs have time to die.

Your role in the team is to deal as much damage to mob clusters as possible, unless the leader asks you to focus on a specific goal. You deal the main damage with an explosive arrow (Q) and caltrops (W), as well as using the passive skill «Good Preparation» (the second passive skill), which strengthens your explosive arrow. 

Don't forget to also use Obsessive Burst (R) to significantly increase your damage. 

This rotation allows you to quickly and effectively deal damage to a large number of enemies, which makes it an excellent choice for farming and PVE content.

description:
This macro is designed for the Albion Online game and works as follows: when the user presses a certain button on the keyboard, the macro will continuously use the skill located in the Q slot. The skill will be used immediately after its rollback, which allows you to use a macro with skills that have different rollback times. This is especially useful when passing difficult dungeons, such as the XCE and the Avalon dungeons, for the DD class and not only.

The macro script checks the presence of a numeric indicator on the skill icon (the color of the numbers should be white). If there is no indicator, the macro will use the skill from the first slot. This means that this macro may not work correctly with skills that have a cast time, but do not have a rollback (since the macro will try to use the skill, which may interrupt the current cast). There may also be problems with skills that have a lot of white on the icon.

In order for the macro to work correctly, you need to set the following settings:
- Screen resolution 1920 x 1080
- Skill icons should be located at the bottom of the screen
- The brightness of the skill icons should be set to 100%
- A numeric indicator is displayed on the skill icons during their recovery

All settings need to be done so that the macro works correctly and can use the skills according to their recovery state.

id: Allods Online/Coins on the Cruiser. Anniversary.amc
title: Coins on the Cruiser. Anniversary
description:
Automating the launch of fireworks on a Cruise liner during the Solemn Anniversary event for Coin pharma is a very convenient way to significantly simplify and speed up the pharma process. To do this, you need to configure a special macro in the Keyran program.

We will describe in detail the steps so that you can successfully configure and use this macro:

1. Launch the Keyran program and find the main screen with an interactive keyboard. In the upper right corner you will see the 'Gears' icon. Click on it. Then select 'Keys'.
2. In the window that opens, find the line 'Run\Stop the program'. Here you need to set the button on the keyboard that will be used to start the farm (for example, 'b').
3. Now configure the driver for more stable operation of the program. On the main screen with an interactive keyboard, find the «Gear» icon in the lower left corner, to the right of the inscription «Driver». Click on it and select 'Install'. After the installation is complete, the program may require a restart of the computer. Reboot and open the program again. Click on the 'Driver' icon to activate it (it should light up red). Make sure that the green label is lit in the 'Gear' to the left of the 'Driver'Installed'.
4. Now let's start setting up the macro itself. On the main screen of the program with an interactive keyboard, pay attention to the keyboard and select the button that you will use to start the farm (for example, 'yu'). Click on this button with the left mouse button and select 'Macro'. Then select 'Coins on the Cruiser. Anniversary'.
5. Now everything is ready! Log in to the game and wait for the start of the Solemn Anniversary event. Go to the launcher so that the 'Z' button appears to start the fireworks, and choose a convenient place to catch coins. Click the button you selected to launch the program (for example, 'b'). You will hear a message in a female voice 'Activated' (if you have not turned off the voiceover in the settings). Then click the button you selected to run the script (for example, 'yu').

Now the script will start working, and you will be able to focus on farming coins while the program will automatically start fireworks at the right moment. To stop the program, just do the opposite: first, click the button to stop the script, and then the button to stop the program. You will hear the message 'Deactivated'.

If you want to change the time range to start the fireworks, the procedure is slightly different:

1. Find the «Editor» icon on the main screen of the program with an interactive keyboard and click on it.
2. On the left side you will see a list of available macros. Select 'Coins on the Cruiser. Anniversary'.
3. The script code will appear on the right side, in one of the lines it will be indicated 'wait from 22 to 50 seconds'. Double-click the left mouse button on this line.
4. Now you can enter the desired time range to start the fireworks. Specify the time 'From 'and 'To' and make sure there is a check mark at the bottom. Then click 'Edit'.
5. In the lower right corner of the editor, find the 'Ok' button and click on it.

Congratulations, you have successfully edited the time range for the fireworks launch! Now you can enjoy the automatic farming of coins on a Cruise ship during the Solemn Anniversary event. Do not forget that the rollback of the fireworks is 20 seconds, so in the field 'From' it is necessary to specify a number of at least 21.

Although it is not perfect, it significantly reduces the impact of recoil, making it more manageable. This is especially useful when using the R301, Flatline, and any «heavy» caliber machine gun, such as the Rampage.

Jitter aiming works by «shaking» your mouse very quickly - in a transverse direction or in a small circle, which, for whatever reason, significantly reduces the recoil of almost all weapons. 

The new «Jitter aim» macro will allow you to automatically activate the «jitter aiming» technique by pressing a certain key on the keyboard or a keyboard shortcut. You can additionally adjust the speed of the mouse «shake» and choose the best angle or form of movement that will work more effectively for each specific type of weapon.

By running the «Jitter aim» macro, you will gain a significant advantage in the game, increasing your accuracy and control over the recoil of weapons. However, keep in mind that using macros may contradict the rules of the game, and this question remains on your conscience. It is always recommended to comply with the terms of use of the game and the rules of fair play.

With the new macro «Jitter aim» you will be able to improve your gaming performance and enjoy more accurate and controlled weapons in Apex Legends.

title: Onion, farm essenic
description:
Setting up this macro is very simple and allows you to optimize the farming process in the Archeage game. The first step is to bind the keys to activate and deactivate the macro. To do this, open the «Settings» in the Keyran program and go to the «Hot Keys» tab. Here we select a convenient keyboard shortcut (for example, Shift + W) and click «OK».

To download the macro itself, go to the «Macro» parameter and click the «Download» button. Select the macro file that we previously save on the desktop, and confirm the selection by clicking «OK».

Now let's move on to configuring the keys. In the «Keys» parameter, select the desired key for farming (it is desirable that it does not conflict with other commands in the game). Press this key, then select «Assign macro» and specify the downloaded macro. After that, click «OK».

Everything is ready! Now it remains to go into the game, activate the program mode by pressing the keyboard shortcut to turn on the macro, and press the specified key to start the macro. Don't forget to stock up on purple cans of mana for long-term farming.

If you need to temporarily disable the macro during the game to perform other actions, you can use the same keyboard shortcut that was specified to activate and deactivate the macro.

This macro is designed to simplify the task in the game Assassin's Creed: Valhalla, related to horse riding and archery.

What does a macro do:
When you aim a bow at a target, the macro automatically fires if the target is in the target.

Execution procedure:
1. Go to the event NPC and launch the «Race for Glory» event.
2. When you are driving, aim at the target by pressing the right mouse button (RMB), and the shot will be automatically made by a macro when the target is in the field of sight.
3. Stop the macro execution after the event is over (if you do not plan to repeat it).

Customization:
The macro is initially configured for a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. If you have a different permission, change line #2 in the macro (under the comment) and enter your permission data as follows: [resolution_x * 0.5]. This will allow the macro to work correctly on your screen resolution.

Example of using a macro:
1. Approach the NPC and launch the «Race for Glory» event.
2. While driving, aim at the target by holding down the right mouse button (RMB), and the macro will automatically fire if the target is in sight.
3. After the event is over, stop the macro execution.
Now you will not need to manually make bow shots, you will have more time to control the horse and achieve victory in the «Race for Glory» event!

The main purpose of this tool is to trick the system that detects user inactivity (AFK timer) in order to avoid disabling the character. Thanks to this, the player can stay in the game without losing his position in the queue, as well as protecting his progress and, in some cases, accumulating game currency or experience even in the AFK state. 

Recommendations for use:

Use the macro in a safe area to avoid a situation in which the character may become immobilized. It is also important to choose spacious spaces, such as train stations or halls, to ensure free movement.

id: Black Russia/Automatic fishing. Read the description of the macro!.amc
title: Automatic fishing. Read the description of the macro!
description:
Thank you for your interest in my macro for automating the fishing process in the game BLACK RUSSIA. As a developer, I advise you to carefully read the description and recommendations on how to use it for the most comfortable and effective game. I hope your gameplay will become much more enjoyable and productive!

### Brief introduction
This macro is designed to simplify and speed up the normal fishing process, minimizing the need for constant monitoring. It automates the key stages — casting the rod and cutting the fish, which significantly saves the player's time and effort. It is ideal for those who want to quickly fill their inventory with fish trophies using available gear.

### Detailed description and algorithm of operation
The macro is designed taking into account the fact that fishing in the game can take a long time due to its monotony. He builds the following sequence of actions: «casting -> waiting for a bite -> hooking.» Thanks to this, the player does not have to sit at the screen waiting.

#### Advantages of using:
One of the main features is economic efficiency. The macro is optimized for the use of inexpensive gear, costing only 50 rubles. They help to reduce the waiting time for a bite from the usual 15 seconds to 10-11 seconds. At first glance, the difference may seem small, but when repeated many times, this time saving turns into a significant advantage.

### How the macro works:

1. **Casting a fishing rod**: When the SPACE BAR is pressed, the macro automatically casts.
   
2. **Waiting for a bite**: After casting, the program takes a pause corresponding to the waiting time, which will be about 10-11 seconds for your gear.
   
3. **Hooking fish**: As soon as a bite arrives, the macro automatically presses the UP ARROW key to hitch.

4. **Action Cycle**: The process repeats indefinitely until your inventory is full.

### Technical information
- **Activation**: Select any key you want to activate (for example, F2).
- **Control keys**: For casting — «SPACE BAR», for cutting — «UP ARROW».
- **Compatibility**: The macro is independent of the screen resolution and works on any device with any graphics settings.

#### Main advantage:
The macro is set up by binding to the keys, which saves you from having to adjust it to different display resolutions. This makes the macro universal for use on any PC.

### Installation and usage
1. Download the macro file to your computer.
2. Assign a convenient key for activation (for example, F2).
3. Make sure that in the game settings the drop key (SPACE BAR) and the sweep key (UP ARROW) are assigned correctly — this is an important requirement.
4. Activate the macro using the key you have assigned.
5. For best results, it is recommended to use inexpensive gear for 50 rubles before starting the process.

### Important points and safety
- **Keep in mind**: the macro does not provide full automation.
- Due to the limitations of the inventory in the game, you will not be able to fish indefinitely. Be sure to keep track of the inventory filling and stop the macro in time.
- It is recommended to stay at the computer and periodically check the condition of the inventory, throwing away unnecessary items.
- The use of macros in BLACK RUSSIA is acceptable. They help optimize routine tasks and reduce the time spent on repetitive activities.
- Before using it, make sure that the drop and sweep keys correspond to those set in the macro (SPACE BAR and UP ARROW).
- To stop the macro, use the same key as to activate it.

Do not forget to control the process, and let this macro become your faithful assistant in fishing! I wish you a successful game and a successful fishing trip!

Welcome to the description of the macro for the Blade Master class, 3rd specialization, in the game Blade and Soul. The macro is optimized for performing rotation.

Before you start using the macro, install it and assign it to a convenient key in the mouse. Now you can run the macro and start the game.

Rotation is carried out as follows: sequential commands are recorded in the macro without delay - FRTT. If necessary, you can additionally manually execute commands, such as pressing the Tab, X, V and 4 keys.

We use the macro V 4 Tab to break into the enemy in the rain blade rack. After using this macro, it is advisable to press the V key to roll it back (if 6 seconds have passed). The X key is also pressed on rollback, except for the moments when we attack under the azura (buff clear sky, accessible by the Tab button). Under azura, we do not press the X key, so as not to reduce the number of pkms under the tab.

Other skills work as follows: you can read their description to understand how they function and include them in the rotation.

The rotation check of the third specialization is carried out by adding the number of ordinary pkms (the Blade of the Dragon of Heaven) and azur pkms (the Blade of the Nameless War) and dividing this amount by time. If the resulting coefficient is 5 or more, then your rotation is considered good. If the result is less than 5, then you are not pressing the buttons enough.

Last note - uncheck «Enhanced techniques» and disable the skills «Tossing kick» (throw) and «Lying block». In PvE, these two skills only get in the way.

The author of the manual is Katsumi. If you have any questions, you can contact him in the game or send a private message to his profile.

title: Brawlhalla hit macro
description:
In Brawlhalla, the term «knowing spear combos» is not widely known or generally accepted. However, it is assumed that you are referring to a specific combo related to the spear weapon in the game.

One of the most popular and effective combos when using a spear in Brawlhalla is «nitchat with a spear» or «combo with a spear». To perform a basic combo with a spear, you usually have to follow this sequence of actions:

Nlight (Neutral Light Attack): Start with a neutral light attack by pressing the attack button without holding the direction. Usually your character performs a quick spear attack, often it can be a poke or a swing.

Search Dash: After a neutral attack, you can make a search dash by quickly pressing the dodge button in any direction. The search jerk is useful for continuing the attack and reducing the distance between you and your opponent.

Slight (side light attack): While performing a search spurt, make a side light attack. This technique is usually a horizontal spear thrust and can lead to a combo if performed correctly.

Additional attacks: Depending on your opponent's position and reaction, you can continue combos with other attacks. Experiment with additional light attacks, air attacks, or signatures to maximize damage and extend combos.

Keep in mind that the effectiveness of a combo can vary depending on a particular legend (character) and the most effective combo works on a character- the inseparable Pince-Nez. Please note that Brawlhalla is an ever-evolving game and specific moves and combos may change with updates and balance changes. I recommend checking out the latest patch notes or watching video guides from experienced players to learn about the most effective spear combos in the current version of the game.

To add a macro or script to the common database in the Keyran program, you will need to perform the following steps:

1. Open the macro or script editor in the Keyran program.
2. Select the file you want to add to the shared database and click the «Share/Expand» button.
3. In the window that opens, describe in detail the task that this macro or script performs. Specify what actions and operations it performs, and what result is expected.
4. Select from the list the name of the game or task for which this macro or script was written. This will allow you to better structure the database and help other users find the solution they need.
5. Click the «Apply» button to submit the file for moderation. Your data will be checked and, upon successful moderation, a macro or script will be added to the general database.

After adding a macro or script to the common database, other Keyran users will be able to use it to solve their tasks. This will help make the program more convenient and effective for everyone.

Adjust the macro by pressing the Shift button (left) to activate the breath hold when aiming with a sniper rifle.

Without using a macro while holding your breath, the sight remains stable for only 3 seconds, after which the effect passes and the sight begins to move. title: CSpam
description:
To execute this macro, you will need the Keyran program. Create a new macro and configure it as follows:
1. Specify the keyboard shortcut that will launch the macro.
2. Add the command «Lock the keyboard for the duration of the macro». This ensures that no other keys are pressed while the macro is running.
3. Add the command «Start the game» or «Switch to the game window». It is important that the macro only works inside the game.
4. Add the command «Press a key», where you specify the necessary key or key combination to perform the desired action in the game.
5. Add the «Unlock Keyboard» command. This will allow you to use the keyboard again after executing the macro.
6. Configure other macro parameters at your discretion, for example, the delay time between keystrokes.

After the configuration is complete, save and run the macro. When you're ready to use it, press the keyboard shortcuts you set.

title: BHOP 144 fps
description:
This macro is an ideal tool for performing bhop in Counter-Strike 1.6 with certain settings. First, you need to enable the display of network statistics (net_graph «1»), which will allow you to monitor ping and other parameters. Next, set the maximum number of frames per second to 144 (fps_max «144») and enable the forced value of the number of frames per second (fps_override «1»). 

It is also important to set optimal parameters for network operation. Set a high client refresh rate (cl_updaterate «102») and the frequency of sending commands to the server (cl_cmdrate «102»). 

It is important to note that this configuration works perfectly only at 144 FPS. If the game takes place at a higher frame rate (200, 300-500-1000), then the jump may be interrupted and the character will «stop». Therefore, it is important to observe strict time delays in this macro. Any changes of 1 ms more or less may result in a change in the character's speed at certain values of fps_max.
author: Keyran / Comunidade

title: DDRUN and SGS 144,300,500,1000 fps
description:
Dear CS 1.6 players, I want to present you a unique macro «DDRUN and SGS». This macro will allow you to achieve the maximum speed of movement on servers with any acceleration. 

To begin with, make sure that you have enabled the display of network statistics (net_graph 1) and used the specified values of the fps_override 1 and fps_max commands. It is recommended to set fps_max from 144 to 1000 to achieve perfect smoothness of the game.
It is also necessary to set the values of rate 100000, cl_updaterate 102 and cl_cmdrate 102 to ensure optimal connection to the server.
Now let's move on to the macro itself. You can assign it to any mouse or keyboard button. The macro will be activated when the specified key is held down.
It is important to note that this macro exactly corresponds to the specified delay timings, which are optimal for achieving maximum speed. Even a small change in these parameters can lead to a decrease in the speed of units at a given fps_max.
By running the macro, you can easily reach speeds of up to +500-700 units per second on a flat surface. You just need to press and hold the selected key, and your character will rush across the map at supersonic speed.
However, it is worth noting that this macro only works on public sites, since it is no longer possible to use this macro on servers with a metamode installed to block short-term delays, such as +duck. 
In conclusion, I want to note that the «DDRUN and SGS» macro will provide you with the maximum speed of movement on CS 1.6 servers with any acceleration. It is recommended to use it on public sites where there is no blocking of short-term delays. Good luck and have a nice game!

This macro in CS:GO allows you to quickly purchase AWP and Deagle, and also switches the keyboard to the English layout. To activate a macro, assign it to a convenient key. For example:

bind «F1» «buy awp; buy deagle; bind F2 'bind F1'»

When pressing F1, AWP and Deagle are automatically purchased, as well as the F2 key is bound to cancel this action. In addition, if necessary, you can add a command to change the keyboard layout:

bind «F1» «buy awp; buy deagle; bind F2 'bind F1'; toggleconsole; bind F3 'toggleconsole; bind F2'»

Now, when you press F1, the purchase of AWP and Deagle will be performed, and the F2 key will cancel this action. Also, the F3 key will open/close the game console.

1. Download and install the Keyran program if you haven't done it yet.
2. Open Keyran and create a new macro.
3. Enter the name of the macro and select the button that is convenient for you to activate it.
4. Hold down the jump button (usually it's a space bar) on the keyboard.
5. Inside the Keyran program, press the record button and release the jump button.
6. Set the delay between jumps so that the macro runs at the frequency you need. 30-40 milliseconds is recommended.
7. Save the macro.
8. Go to the CS:GO game settings and assign the «Jump» button (usually Space) on the keyboard.
9. Start the game and log in to the server or match.
10. Press the button to which you have assigned the macro in the Keyran program to activate the auto-release.

Now your character will automatically perform jumps in CS:GO when holding the activating button.

title: Quick crafting
description:
This macro is designed for accelerated crafting of things in the game Cyberpunk 2077 using the mouse. It simulates pressing the left mouse button to quickly perform an action.

Before using the macro, you need to change the animation settings of the crafting status bar in the game. To do this, follow the instructions:

1. Open the file inputContexts.xml , located in the \Cyberpunk 2077\r6\config folder, by any text editor.
2. In this file, find the line with the attribute hold action=«craft_item».

title: Password selection 1000 in 17.5 minutes
description:
To change the binding of the «Interaction with the environment» key from the letter F to the LMB, follow the following steps:

1. Open the Keyran program and find the «Management» or «Key Settings» section.
2. In this section, find the «Interaction with the environment» option and open it for editing.
3. Instead of the letter F, select the option «LMB» or «Left Mouse Button».
4. Save the changes.

Please note that after changing the key binding on the LMB, you will need to remove the LMB binding from the «Action with subject» option to avoid a conflict. This can be done as follows:

1. Select the «Action with the item» option in the «Management» or «Key Settings» section.
2. Remove the LMB or Left Mouse Button binding from this option.
3. Save the changes.

After that, you can use the paintwork to interact with the environment.

Now, if you want to use a macro to perform a certain action, for example, breaking a lock, use the following instructions:

1. Make sure that you have selected the last digit of the lock code (4th, rightmost).
2. Make sure that all digits of the lock code after the first one are zero.
3. If the first digit of the lock code is thousands, select any other suitable digit (for example, 3000, 4000, 1000, etc.).
4. Set the rewind time to 100-105 seconds or another value suitable for you.
5. If for some reason you need more time, you can use the values 1000 for rewinding in 17.5 minutes or 10,000 for rewinding in 3 hours.
6. Turn on the macro and wait for the hacking process to complete.
7. After a successful hack, do not forget to return the control key bindings as they were assigned earlier to avoid problems with further gameplay.

Now you can effectively change the binding of the «Interaction with the environment» key, use a macro to crack locks and enjoy the gameplay in DayZ.

title: CodeLock-auto
description:
The average time to select 1000 combinations using this script is 19 minutes and 20 seconds, which is 1 minute slower than with manual selection. While for other scripts, due to their features, this time is 20-25 minutes.

It is important to note that this program ensures the operation of the game without lags, which is very important for a comfortable gameplay.

To use the script, you need to do the following: 

1. Move the lock scroll from the F key to the left mouse button.
2. Set the binding (bind) also on the left mouse button.

This is followed by the process of selecting the lock:

1. Set any value of a thousand (X).
2. Set the lock to the value X0[0]0. Please note that the number selection must be in the third position.
3. Run the script and click on the left mouse button in the game.
4. The script will automatically scroll the lock a thousand times.
5. After reaching a thousand combinations, stop the script, change the value of a thousand (X) and repeat the algorithm of actions for the next combination.

Thus, with the help of this script, you will be able to automate the process of selecting a lock in the DayZ game, reducing the time spent on this action and ensuring optimal functioning of the game.

title: DayZ codelock cracker
description:
A macro for hacking three- and four-digit lock codes on servers with anti-raid in the game DayZ. This macro was specially designed to work with an anti-raid that blocks the F key. Thanks to this macro, you can easily pick up the code to open the lock.

Instructions for use:
1. While breaking the lock in the game, reassign the interaction key to the left mouse button (LMB), since the action tied to the keyboard key can be blocked by anti-raid.
2. Set the lock value from 0000 to 9000.
3. Move the slider to the initial position for the code.
4. Press the key that activates this macro.

The macro will only iterate over numbers within one thousand, switching between thousands will need to be done manually. This is done to ensure security and avoid failures during code selection.
It is important to remember that during the selection of the code, your Internet should be stable and not loaded, since DayZ is very demanding on the bandwidth of the channel. Out-of-sync with the server may affect the success of breaking the lock.
The number of iterations of the last digit of the code is 11, not 10, as is usually required. This is done for reliability, since it is better to be safe in the DayZ game.
The process of selecting thousands of codes will take about 20-25 minutes. Manually, you can pick up the code in 18 minutes, but I specifically made the macro slower to take into account the possibility of input lag. While the program is running, you can relax and have a cup of tea.

title: INVOKER 7.38 - Top Castes with Cataclysm
description:
Hello, dear Dota 2 players! I am pleased to present you a unique macro created specifically for the Invoker hero, which will allow you to effectively use his powerful spells, including deadly cataclysm. First, I will share with you the controls and settings for the skills, and then I will tell you about the work of the macro in more detail.

**Please note!**
It is recommended to use a resolution of 1920 x 1080 for optimal macro performance. Be sure to read the instructions in full to avoid possible errors in use.

### Skill Settings
These are the keys responsible for your character's abilities.:

| Key | Assignment |
|---------|--------------------------------------|
| Q       | Quas                                 |
| W       | Wex                                  |
| E       | Exort                                |
| D | The first skill (for example, Cold Snap) |
| F | Second skill (for example, Deafening Blast) |
| R | Skill Caste (cataclysm)            |

### Inventory Settings

| Key | Subject | Usage Description |
|---------|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Z | Refresher Orb | Use manually to avoid conflicts with the macro |
| X | Shiva's Guard | Activation is performed automatically as part of a macro |
| C|Gleipnir | Is also automatically activated while the macro is running |

### How the macro functions

Approach the opponent and activate the macro by pressing the appropriate key. It will perform the following actions:
1. Fast Meteor casting (Sun Strike) using Exort.
2. Automatic item activation: first Shiva's Guard (X), and then Gleipnir (C).
3. After applying the items, a powerful cataclysm follows (a combination of Invoke and Deafening Blast).
4. After 2 seconds of cataclysm activation, the macro will automatically perform a Ghost Walk and reactivate the Deafening Blast to control the enemy and protect itself.
5. The mouse cursor will move to the center of the screen to ensure the accuracy of the next action.

### Necessary conditions for successful use

- The screen configuration must be strictly set to 1920 x 1080.
- Make sure that all binds are configured correctly.
- The cursor must be positioned as close to the enemy as possible before activating the macro.
- The items used are essential for complete success — without them, opportunities will be significantly reduced.
- Be sure to enable the Quick Cast feature in the game settings.
- Your Invoker level must be at least 30 to gain access to all necessary skills.
- Refresher Orb should only be used manually, outside of the macro operation.

### Useful tips

I recommend practicing with the macro on bots in advance to get a feel for how it works. Keep an eye on the cursor position, as incorrect positioning can lead to loss of efficiency. Use this macro as a component of your overall strategy, combining it with your team's actions.

I hope that this macro will help you achieve new heights and victories on the battlefields of Dota 2! Have fun playing the game and feel free to leave comments or ask questions!

This ability requires the presence of three Invoked Spheres, which can be created using the abilities «Quas», «Wex» and «Exort». The key to the effective use of «Cold Snap» is constant practice. Be sure to train your Invoker skills to perform a keyboard shortcut quickly and accurately. The more you play on Invoker, the more natural it becomes to use «Cold Snap» at the right moments.

In addition, be attentive to the correct position and the choice of the goal. Using the «Cold Snap» on an enemy who is in the wrong position or has already used his abilities to escape can be especially effective.

Remember that Dota 2 is a dynamic game, and every match is unique. The ability to adapt and use skills such as «Cold Snap» strategically is what distinguishes successful Invoker players. Script for Invoker in Keyran:

8. If there is Hex or Orchid, activate them, otherwise continue immediately to the next step
9. Press the «F» button (the button to activate the macro)
10. Press the «E» button twice (to activate E + E abilities)
11. Press the «Q» button (to activate the Quas sphere)
12. Summon Forges

 The general sequence of actions for using the Invoker macro in Dota 2 using Keyran is as follows:

1. Click on the second cell.
2. Press the «B» button to activate Ghost Walk.
3. Hold down the «W» key to activate Cold Snap.
4. Hold down the «E» key three times to activate the Wex sphere.
5. Release the «W» key to stop activating Cold Snap.
6. Press the «D» button to activate Ghost Walk.
7. Point the cursor at the opponent.
8. If there is Hex or Orchid, activate them, otherwise continue to the next step.
9. Press the «F» button to activate the macro.

To use the macro correctly, place the mouse cursor on the enemy. Then press and hold the key that the macro is bound to. It is important to keep holding the key while performing the Astral and moving the cursor to the area of action of the Meteor Hammer after the Astral.
Make sure that you use quickcasts (quick application of abilities without the need to select a target) and enable the «Stop abilities with a separate key» function in the settings.
However, keep in mind that this macro will be useless if the enemy has items that provide resistance to effects such as Sange and Kaya or Sange and Yasha. In such cases, the macro will not work.

id: Elite Dangerous/Data farm on a megachip.amc
title: Data farm on a megachip
description:
This macro is designed for automated collection of encrypted data in AFK (Away From Keyboard) mode. To successfully carry out this action, you need to prepare your ship by equipping it with special modules, including cargo racks and a controller for reconnaissance drones.

The first task is to detect a «megachip» of the «Bulk Cruiser (Science Vessel)» type. To do this, I recommend using the resource «inara.cz «. Find the “DATA» section on the top panel of the site, then select the “Search for the nearest» option. In the form that appears, enter the system you are in in the “Nearest system» field. Further in the section “Station type” select “Bulk Cruiser (Science Vessel)». Don't forget to click on the “VIEW ADDITIONAL OPTIONS» button. In the window that opens, specify “Low Anarchy” in the “Security level” and click the search button. Pay attention to the megachip marked «Lowtll-class», as this particular class of ships does not have protective systems.

After finding the right system, go there and open the navigation bar. If it does not display the megachip you are looking for, try to fly up to the navigation beacon by scanning it (to do this, aim and fly closer than 1000 meters). After that, when you switch to hyper-jump mode, the required megachip should appear on your navigation bar.

When you fly up to the megachip, it is important to make sure that it is not under attack from pirates. To do this, climb 1-2 kilometers to the megachip and wait for a couple of minutes. If he is not attacked, he will not require your help. If there is an attack, it is better to move away and try to find another megachip. When you find a megachip unsupported by the attack, scan it. On the «Contacts» tab, you can find «Data transmitter (possible hacking)».

Now let's move on to the correct positioning of your ship. For the macro to work correctly, fly up to the data transmitter at a distance of no more than 350 meters. This will allow you to capture it in the scope and scan it. Make sure that your ship is positioned along the megachip — this will make it easier to switch between sights. It is recommended to turn the ship over so that the megachip is on top, which will prevent accidental destruction of the scout drones when they are launched.

After completing all the necessary steps, you can activate the macro and calmly go about your business, for example, make tea.

important:
1. Set up the firing groups: the data channel scanner should be on key 1 (left mouse button activation), and the scout drones on key 2 (right mouse button release).
2. Run the macro from the main menu of the game.
3. If the macro does not work correctly, try changing the timings that are responsible for the delay after selecting a single-player game or entering the main menu.

You can find additional information and video instructions on how to find the right megachip in this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qpoXspGEE-Q

Don't forget to stock up on drones before starting your expedition, Commander! Good luck in your search!

title: Fallout 4 Auto Store Scrap Exploit
description:
This macro is designed to duplicate the covers in the Fallout 4 game, using a well-known exploit related to garbage, but applied to shops in settlements. The exploit allows you to store and disassemble an object at the same time, which actually doubles its number each time you use it. A similar principle can be applied to built facilities in settlements, although it works somewhat differently. Instead of directly doubling the materials, during the storage of the object, part of the used resources is returned to you, thereby allowing you to return the item to its place and use the exploit again to obtain additional materials at no cost. The stores that you disassemble return some of your lids, so if you successfully apply this method, you will be able to infinitely increase the number of lids.

To get started, you will need existing covers and any resources to create a store, as well as 2 ranks of «Local Leader» (level 14 and charisma 6 are required). As soon as you can place the most expensive store, open the workshop menu on the store type category and hover the cursor over your store. Run the macro, and it should successfully duplicate your covers and immediately install another store. When you have accumulated enough caps to buy a more expensive store, run the macro again with a new object to get even more caps. Repeat the process until you accumulate a huge amount!

However, it is worth noting that this method is not ideal. The macro works correctly if you run it once at a time, but in constant loop mode it may not execute the exploit properly. For best results, it is recommended to run it every time you press the assigned button. I'll try to adapt the macro to work in a continuous loop, but for now it's better to use it the old-fashioned way by running it manually.

title: Press E for Port-A-Diner
description:
The macro for the extraction of «Perfectly preserved pie». 

1. Find a «Portable Lunch» on the territory of Shelter 76, for example, in a rusty pickaxe or other similar places.

2. Make sure that the mouse cursor is over the machine.

3. Run our unique macro and allow yourself to do other things while the program will automatically try to get a pie.

Chance of getting a pie:

The probability of getting a pie depends on the value of the main characteristic «Luck». A higher «Luck» value increases the chance of getting a pie.

The formula for calculating the chance:

Chance = (Luck x 4) + attempts / 20

Chance is the percentage chance of getting a pie.
Luck is the luck value of the player's character.
Attempts - the number of previous unsuccessful attempts to get a pie.

For example, with luck equal to 10, the chance of getting a pie on the first attempt is only 2%.

So, summing up the probabilities, the player's character with a luck value of 5 has a 50% chance of getting a pie during the first 36 attempts. Luck 10 reduces this number to 26 attempts, while luck 1 increases it to 49 attempts.

In total, depending on the value of luck, the player will need from 75 to 105 attempts to achieve a 95% chance of getting a pie, and from 109 to 140 attempts to achieve a 99.5% chance. In any case, the number of attempts should not exceed 2000.

Using our macro, you will be able to automatically continue trying to mine the pie, allowing you to do other things while the program does everything by itself.

Making changes to macros is an important step to make them unique and effective for the Fortnite game. Below are some practical tips to help you create the perfect macro:

1. Learn the features of the game: To create effective macros, you need to carefully study the game mechanics of Fortnite. Understanding shooting, building and movement in the game will help you create macros that will respond accurately and as efficiently as possible.

2. Choose the right equipment: The quality of your mouse and keyboard also matters. High-quality devices will allow you to aim more accurately and perform actions faster. It is important to choose the equipment that suits your needs and style of play.

3. Create Macros: Specialized mouse and keyboard software will allow you to create macros to perform certain actions. For example, you can create macros for quick shooting, building walls, or editing structures. Keep in mind that macros should be balanced and not give you an unfair advantage over other players.

4. Testing and Configuration: After creating macros, it is important to test them in the game and configure them so that they are most effective. Try using macros in different situations in the game and customize them according to your needs and preferences.

5. Uniqueness and Individuality: To make macros unique, you can add additional elements, such as keyboard shortcuts, pauses and random mouse movements. You can try adding a slight delay between actions so that macros look natural and avoid detection by the anti-cheat system.

6. Ethics: It is important to remember that the use of macros should not violate the rules of the game. Do not use macros for cheating, such as automatic shooting or editing structures contrary to the rules of the game. Be ethical and use macros only to automate actions that are allowed in the game.

7. Be careful: Always remember that using macros can lead to account ban. Before using macros in Fortnite, read the user agreement and the rules of the game to make sure that their use is not prohibited. Take care of your account and use macros with caution.

The perfect macro in Fortnite is the one that maximizes efficiency and allows you to play at a high level. It should be unique, adapted to your needs and comply with the rules of the game. Remember that using macros can give you pleasure from the game, but do not abuse them and create an unfair advantage over other players.

title: Fortnite Fast Edit Float Macro
description:
This unique macro is specially designed to optimize the editing process in Fortnite. It will allow you to edit buildings quickly and efficiently, but it will require a little configuration to work.

1. Setting up game keys

Before you start using the macro, you need to make certain key settings in the game. Go to the Fortnite lobby and open the settings menu by clicking on the gear icon at the top of the screen. Then scroll down and find the «Edit» section. Make sure that the «Edit by Release» option is enabled, otherwise the macro will not work fast enough.

Then go to the «Key Bindings» section in the «Settings» menu. Scroll down to the «Building» section and find the key binding for editing buildings. Press the edit buildings button for the F key and add an additional binding for editing on the Y key.

Congratulations! The game keys setup is complete. Now we will proceed to setting up the macro in the Keyran program.

2. Setting up Keyran

After uploading the macro file to the Keyran editor, go to the «Keys» section. A virtual keyboard should appear on the screen. Find the macro enable key and click on it. Then select the last option «Start before pressing again». This means that the macro will be executed until you press the key again to stop.

After that, press the desired key on the virtual keyboard again and select the macro «Fortnite - Quick editing of a floating macro».

Congratulations! You have successfully configured Keyran to use the macro. Click the Start button and get ready to experience incredible speed and efficiency in editing Fortnite. If you have any questions or need additional help, feel free to contact me via Discord - LTTSTORE.COM#9693.

description:

The macro uses the ENTER keys to confirm actions, ESCAPE keys to exit, and arrows to scroll through lists. Please note that this macro is relevant for August 2023, when there are 752 cars in the game Forza Horizon 4, and they are located in the auction list in the specified order.

id: Genshin Impact/Hu Tao best hold attack spam.amc
title: Hu Tao best hold attack spam
description:
Greetings! Here is a unique and Russian descriptive text for a macro that will help you automatically perform a Hu Tao hold attack by using a jump:

This macro is designed for the Genshin Impact game and is designed for convenient use of the Hu Tao character's hold attack. It allows you to automatically perform 9 hold attacks within a single rack, which will significantly increase your effectiveness in combat.

To use the macro, you need to follow these steps:

1. Assign a key that will control the macro (for example, R or V). Choose the most convenient option for you.

2. Hold the assigned key to activate the macro.

The macro can be easily stopped at any time by simply releasing the assigned key. This will not cause any negative consequences.

But it is important to note the following:

1. The macro cannot determine the hitlag mechanics and the distance to the target if it is not built into the game. In this regard, in order to ensure a comfortable game against opponents with shields, and to avoid problems when the enemy is at a distance, it is recommended to change the waiting value of the second line from 370 to 470!

Hitlag is a game mechanic that causes a short-term frame delay when Hu Tao's weapon hits the shield, increasing the «sensitivity» of the blow. This means that the game intentionally delays one frame by a few milliseconds when Hu Tao hits the hilichurla shield. Because of this, the script may not work, because it is intended only for standard conditions (hitting the enemy CLOSELY without a shield). Please take this into account when using the macro or change the value of waiting for the second line. It is recommended to set the value to 470 instead of 370 to solve both problems.

2. All timings in the macro were not selected as efficiently as possible to ensure stable operation of the script. A slight loss of a few milliseconds is not a serious problem, since the number of stable hold attacks carried out within one rack is 9 while waiting for 370 in the second row. Timings were selected based on an average ping of 60 ms and stable FPS.

If it is more convenient for you to use a one-click macro, the macro provides a cycle of 9 repetitions. If you only need to repeat the macro ONCE, just delete the last two lines (waiting 600 ms and loop: repeat 9 times).

Enjoy the game with pleasure!

title: Diluc dragonstrike
description:
Please note that this script is designed for the Genshin Impact game and is optimized for ping 57-60. If the script does not work, you will need to change the delay value in the 5th line. Instead of the value 245, set the appropriate value. It is recommended to try values in the range 200-300. 

The most convenient way to select the necessary delay is to use blows on trees. 

Dragonstrike is a mechanics that strongly depends on ping, so it is advisable to study the theory before coming to terms with the cognitive distortion of subjective expectations and the easy binary profit of an excel accountant. However, I warn you that many complex terms will be used in this description, and it may be difficult to understand.

The essence of dragonstrike is that when you press the acceleration button during the hitlag mechanics and the subsequent jump, the character converts horizontal acceleration into vertical momentum sufficient to perform a plange attack out of the blue.

Hitlag is the mechanics of a small frame delay when hitting an enemy with a two-handed weapon or when hitting a shield, which gives the strike greater «sensitivity» and dynamism in battle. This means that the game intentionally delays one frame by a few milliseconds on impact. Therefore, it is important to understand that THE SCRIPT WILL NOT WORK WHEN HIT IN THE AIR, BECAUSE IT DEPENDS ON THE DELAY WITH THE HITLAG.

Note also that to simplify the execution of the dragonstrike mechanics, you can use buffs to increase the speed of movement, such as Dione's shield, Gin's S2 or anemo resonance.

By the way, Eshek also has a hitlag, but her three-hit combo attack has different timings, so flexibility and a good reaction are required.

Enjoy slashing enemies and exploring the pixel world with the help of anime mechanics!

description:
This macro is designed to automate the stew cooking process in GTA 5 RP and completely eliminates the need for the user to interfere during operation. It can perform all actions sequentially and without failures.:

1. Opens the refrigerator.
2. Extracts the required amount of vegetables from the specified slot.
3. Prepares the stew using a blender.
4. Returns the finished dish back to the refrigerator.

To ensure stable operation, all operations are performed at extended intervals, which helps reduce the likelihood of interface failures and camera problems. You don't have to worry about timings, as they can be adjusted according to your preferences.

IMPORTANT INSTALLATIONS

- The key to open the inventory is U (if you use another key, it should be changed either in the game settings or in the macro code).
- Window mode: windowless without frame.
- Aspect ratio: 16:9.
- Resolution: 1920×1080.

PREPARING FOR LAUNCH

Before starting work, make sure that you have access to water — the macro will not function without it. Then follow these steps:

1. Open the refrigerator.
2. Arrange the vegetables 40 at a time in the first six slots.
3. Close the refrigerator.
4. Place the blender in the first slot of your inventory.
5. Close the inventory.
6. Stand directly in front of the refrigerator.
7. Run the macro.

HOW THE MACRO WORKS

Each vegetable slot is processed separately. After processing one slot is completed, the macro automatically moves on to the next one. As a result, you can cook up to 240 stews in one run (6 slots of 40 each).

LEAD TIME

The approximate cooking time for 40 units of stew is 5.5 minutes. The full cycle, covering 240 servings, will take about 35 minutes.

title: driftTavrida
description:
The macro for drift in the AMAZING ONLINE game is designed for a screen resolution of 1440x900 and was created specifically for the Toyota Mark II JZX100 car. For optimal use of this macro, compliance with certain technical characteristics of the vehicle is required. Here they are:

- Stage: 2
- Camber of wheels: front and rear
- Anti-radar: available
- Alarm system: available
- Audio System: missing
- Strobe lights: No
- Nitro: no
- Air suspension: missing
- Hydraulics: no
- Ground clearance: 5%
- Drift smoke: no
- Additional tank: +35 liters
- Additional trunk: missing

If your car does not have the specified technical characteristics, the drift may fail, which will lead to withdrawal from the race.

Now let's look at how to use this macro correctly on the «Ascent to Taurida» drift track. In order to find this route, you need to drive through the tunnel to the city of Yuzhny, and then turn left. After walking a little bit, you will see a sign on the asphalt with an image of a car painted blue, and purple smoke behind it. At this stage, it is important to rest against the bump on the right side of the structure, driving a little forward to hit the wall.

After that, you need to use the combination of the W and S keys while holding them down. Then, without releasing these keys, turn to the right to perform a 180-degree turn. After turning around, click the left mouse button to open a menu where you will see several sections, including «Drift». There will be two buttons in this section: the first is the «Leaderboard», where you can view the top 10 winners, and the second is «Start», where you can start your drift race.

Important: make sure that you hit the bump and turn 180 degrees, otherwise the macro will not work! After pressing the «Start» button, a 3-second timer will start. At this time, open the chat by pressing the F6 button and enter the /end command. After that, press Enter twice, and then press LMB again on the «Start» button. These actions are necessary in order for the bug to work, which will add you + 3 seconds to the race, and the macro will be able to collect more drift points.

After launching, allow the macro to drive the entire route, collecting all the Kist the wall and speed bumps. You will get extra points for a perfect drift. As a result, you need to score about 40,000 drift points to place in the top 3 or 4. Manually scoring 40,000 points is quite difficult, so this macro will be very useful. Thank you for your attention, good luck on the drift!
author: Keyran / Comunidade

title: drift
description:
This macro is designed to effectively get drift points on the Anashan-Arzamas highway in the Amazing Online game. You will use a Toyota Mark II car that is tuned to the Stage 2 tuning level with a properly positioned camber of the front and rear wheels, a body kit and a maximum clearance of 100%. It is suitable for a screen resolution of 1440x900 pixels. 

First, you need to bring the car to a special marker on the asphalt, which depicts a car emitting smoke in the colors of the blue-violet spectrum. After installing on this label, you should activate the macro. After that, all actions are performed automatically. 

What does this macro do? First of all, he bypasses the system by activating a bug that adds time to your score, which allows you to score more points. To do this, the macro presses the left mouse button to activate the «Start» function, then opens the chat, enters the /end command and confirms it by pressing Enter, activating «Start» again. This adds an additional 3 seconds to the main check-in time. 

After completing this operation, the macro starts moving along the most optimal trajectory, collecting available bonuses to get additional drift points. Every 15 seconds, his rear bumper touches a bump or other objects on the track, which earns +3,500 points. In addition, every 12 seconds he performs a «fast shift» maneuver, while accelerating to 95 km/ h or more, which adds another 1,500 drift points. All you have to do is activate the macro and watch the process.

1. First download this macro from the site where it is published.
2. Run the Keyran program, then open the macro editor. At the bottom of the screen you will see a horizontal menu. Click on the button that is located to the right of the open folder. Then find the downloaded macro file and open it.

4. After successfully installing the macro, close the macro editor. Now select the button you want to install this macro on and click on the program launch button (the triangle in the frame next to the right ctrl).

title: Potemkin GiganticL
description:
This macro completely emulates the Giganter reception → Gigantic Bullet (consisting of two phases) of the character Potemkin in the game Guilty Gear.

To perform a move, your character must look to the left. Here is the instruction for executing the macro:

The first phase:
- Press the ←↙↓↘→ keys and then the ←+ key [insert the desired key here]
500 ms delay
The second phase:
- Press the →↘↓↙← keys, and then the →↘↓↙← + keys [insert the desired K key here]

Please note that you can replace the «K key» and «[key» with any key convenient for you in the Keyran Macro Editor. Make sure that the selected keys match your stroke layout in the game.
If you notice that the second phase is not being performed, you can change the delay between phases to adjust to the requirements of the game.
Please note that the direction layout in the game must be on WASD in order for the macro to work correctly.

If your character is looking to the right, you can find a macro called «Potemkin GiganticR», which will be adapted to your orientation.

title: Potemkin GiganticR
description:
As soon as your character looks to the right, you will be able to execute this macro to receive Giganter → Gigantic Bullet (consisting of two phases) in the character Potemkin in the game Guilty Gear.

Please make sure that your keyboard is set to the WASD layout before running the macro.

The following macro will completely copy the reception:

1. The first phase:
- Press and hold → (right arrow), then ↘ (down arrow and right), ↓ (down arrow), ↙ (down arrow and left), and finally ← (left arrow).
- Then quickly press → (right arrow) and then the [key.
- Wait for a delay of 500 milliseconds.

2. The second phase:
- Press and hold ← (left arrow), then ↙ (down arrow and left), ↓ (down arrow), ↘ (down arrow and right), and finally → (right arrow).
- Then quickly press ← (left arrow), ↙ (down arrow and left), ↓ (down arrow), ↘ (down arrow and right), and again → (right arrow), and then the K key.

You can adjust the [ and K keys in the editor of the subject program, make sure that the selected keys correspond to your layout of strokes in the game.

title: hk qga skip
description:
The QGA skip is a technique that is used by players seeking to shorten the passage time in the Hollow Knight game by manipulating the physical characteristics and animations of the character. In version 1.2.2.1, this trick works reliably if certain conditions are met and a macro is used to speed up command input.

First of all, find the right platform, which is located at a height slightly above ground level, where your character is located. This is the lower platform where you usually find yourself in front of the place where you need to perform a QGA skip.

When starting to skip, it is important to stand not in the center of the platform, but slightly to the right of its middle. This is critical because in this section of the platform, the hitboxes (collision boundaries) of the hero and the objects of the game world are configured so that this causes the required animation failure.

To make this skip, follow these steps:

1. Approach the lower platform at the specified location.
2. Make sure that you stand on the right side of the platform, with your right foot resting on the edge.
3. Run the macro with the correct command input sequence.

If you do it this way, the game activates the QGA effect, allowing you to skip a significant portion of the gameplay and significantly speed up your passing time.

title: The Magician's Combo
description:
As an experienced player who spent several years on the first Ikarus server before its closure and continues to play on the new Foenix server, I want to share my best practices. If you, like me, prefer magic classes, then I recommend using the following keyboard shortcuts: assign «ice claw» to key 2, «frost bomb» to F2, and «ice squall» to key 5. 

Additionally, on key 1, set «taming» to level 3, «fire fang», and on F3 you will have «fire bomb», while on 4 - «lightning» (or «Thunderstorm»). I have thoroughly tested this macro, but keep in mind that it is better not to change the delay between beats. If you click too fast, the game may not recognize your actions and this will lead to crashes. With this scenario, you can easily cope with medium-stat mobs, and the weak ones simply won't have time to withstand the «volley».

title: The Witch's Combo
description:
The most powerful melee combo of the witch at low levels:

1. Assign the «Vacuum» ability to the right mouse button. This ability attracts enemies to you.

2. We assign the ability «Crushing chaos» to the «1» key. After attracting enemies with the «Vacuum», using this ability will throw them aside. This will create serious problems for any opponent in PvP or PvE.

3. We assign the «Binding Light» ability to the «F2» key. This ability is used to enhance the effects of other abilities. When activated before the «Crushing Chaos», it increases its damage and range.

4. Do not forget about the ability «Flurry of dark arrows», which can be activated by pressing the «4» key. This ability deals direct damage to enemies and can be a great addition to combos.

Thus, with this combo, you will be able to attract enemies using the «Vacuum», then use the «Binding Light» and inflict powerful damage on them with the «Crushing Chaos», and then complete the attack with the «Barrage of dark arrows». These two combo teams will allow you to take full advantage of the full power of the witch!

2. Assign any crossbow skill to the right button, preferably one that deals combo damage. But if you don't have such a skill, you can use, for example, a double shot.

3. Launch the macro and start attacking monsters by flying around them in a circular motion with the help of a flying pet. The macro will run automatically until you stop it.

4. It is important to remember that there may be monsters flying at close range from you. Keep in mind that they can attack you and pose a threat to your character. Be careful and skillfully dodge attacks.

Using this macro, you can effectively attack mobs while staying safe at altitude on your flying pet. However, keep in mind that the macro may require some refinement over time.

title: Auto-farm winter cup glasses
description:
Welcome to the description of the macro for collecting water in the Crying Oasis location in the Supersaturated Wastelands region of the Icarus game. 

This macro will automatically take the quest from the NPC, collect water and hand it over, allowing you to quickly get points in the Winter Cup pass.

First of all, make sure that you have enabled the automatic rejection of trades, duels, exchanges and other requests. This will help to avoid problems while the macro is running.

It is also recommended to disable the interface while the macro is running to minimize the risk of the game sagging and possible disruptions in the macro. To do this, you can use the Cntrl + / key combination.

Before starting farming, you need to position yourself between the NPC and the lake, facing the NPC. 

So, after launching the macro, it will automatically take the quest from the NPC, taking all the necessary actions for this. Then the macro will move to the lake and begin the process of collecting water.

Since one quest takes about 30 seconds to complete, you can get 120 pass points in 1 hour. This means that you will be able to earn all the pass rewards in just 25 hours, which is a record-breaking fast way. Usually, 90 days are allocated for earning such a number of points.

It is recommended to run the macro before going to bed and leave it running throughout the night. This way you will be able to enjoy the new earned pass rewards in the morning.

We wish everyone a successful farm of points in the Icarus Phoenix game!

In this macro, we use the following buttons on the keyboard:

- Auto-attack is assigned to the Q key. When you click on it, the character will automatically attack the nearest enemy.

- To turn the screen to the right, use the NumPad 3 key. This is necessary so that the character is always aimed at the target and can deal damage.

- Summoning pets can be assigned to the Z key. When you click on it, the character's ability to summon pets is activated, which will help in the battle.

Also, this macro can work with auto-loot. This means that the character will automatically collect loot from the killed mobs.

If you have experience in changing binds (assigning keys), then you can change them in this macro to suit your preferences.

This macro will allow you to farm mobs around with ease, without being distracted by character rotation and activation of abilities.

id: Infestation_ The New Z/Chat Spam TRADING.amc
title: Chat Spam TRADING
description:
Welcome to the instructions for using the macro for spam in the TRADING server chat in the Infestation game: The New Z. 

First of all, you will need to create a text file using any text editor (for example, Notepad) on your computer. In this file you can write messages about the sale, purchase or exchange of items. When the text is ready, select it and copy it to the clipboard using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+C.

Then collapse the text editor and bind the macro to a convenient key or mouse button in the Keyran program. It is important to set the macro operation mode so that it is executed only once when a key or mouse button is pressed.
Now go to one of the TRADING servers in the Infestation game: The New Z. Run the macro by pressing the assigned key or mouse button. The macro will duplicate the message exactly three times to avoid being banned. 
In order not to be banned for spam, it is important to monitor the chat and react after each message written by another player. As soon as you see a new message in the TRADING chat, click the macro. Thus, the program will send three messages to the chat at a time. 
After each of your messages, the system will issue a spam warning, so do not exceed the limit of three messages after each message from another player to avoid being banned. 
If you need to make changes to your message, open the file in a text editor, make the necessary edits, copy the text to the clipboard and continue spamming in the TRADING chat. 
If you have any questions, you can contact me via private messages in this group or through the program in which the macro is bound and run.

title: Autokill+Barricade+main weapon
description:
The macro «AutoHill + Barricade + main weapon!» will help you automatically use hillocks, barricade and main weapons in the game. To use the macro, first you need to bind the barricade to the «4» key, the hillocks to the «3» key and the main weapon to the «1» key. Then set the macro to any key convenient for you. 

It is important to note that if you are unable to put a barricade in the jump, you can increase the delay value on the «4» key by a few milliseconds, for example, 102 ms. This will allow you to successfully put a barricade in the jump.

This macro will greatly simplify the process of using hillocks, barricades and main weapons in the game, allowing you to quickly activate all these functions with a single key. Use it for your health and good luck in the game!
