id: Infestation_ The New Z/Zoom delay sight.amc
title: Zoom delay sight
description:
Improved macro for the Infestation game: The New Z is a combination of zoom and sight delay!
Now you don't need to hold the «CapsLock» to activate the sight delay!
Just adjust the «8» key to delay the sniper rifle sight in the game and link this macro to the mouse PCM!
Now the PCM will automatically turn on the zoom of the sight at the same time with a delay, which makes using the sight more convenient and simple!
author: Keyran / Comunidade

title: L85-PVP
description:
This macro for use with L85 will be effective only on PVP servers in the game. It is designed in such a way as to be used without any modular butts, handles and optical sights. It is important to note that it is designed for a full clip of 60 rounds.

To properly configure the macro, it is recommended to set the sensitivity in the game to 6, and change the DPI of your mouse in the range from 800 to 1600.
The macro is designed to be used in three modes: when shooting from under the sight from the third person, when shooting from the hip and when shooting immediately after raising the weapon to the eyes from the first person (you can use the front sight). 
We recommend using modular compensators to reduce the spread and increase accuracy. This will help reduce accidental deviations when shooting.
This macro provides you with improved accuracy and control over L85 weapons, which is important on PVP servers where speed and accuracy play a crucial role.
author: Keyran / Comunidade

title: FAMAS-PVP
description:
This macro for FAMAS is intended exclusively for use on PVP servers in the Infestation game: The New Z. It is designed to be used without any modular butts, handles and optical sights. The macro is designed for a clip of 30 rounds, which allows you to effectively use the weapon in combat.

Before using the macro, you need to set the sensitivity in the game at 6 and the mouse DPI in the range from 800 to 1600. These settings will help to achieve the best result and accuracy when shooting.
The mode of operation of the macro includes shooting from the third person, shooting from the hip and shooting on the jump from the first person. This allows you to shoot in different situations and from different positions, improving overall efficiency and mobility in combat. You can also use a front sight instead of an optical sight.
It is recommended to use modular compensators to reduce the spread and increase the accuracy of the weapon. This will help increase your hit chance and gun control.
If you use low sensitivity or DPI in aiming mode, we recommend making a small adjustment of the «Y» axis downwards. This will help you aim more accurately and control the recoil of the weapon.

title: IMITAR21-PVP
description:
This macro is for use with the IMI TAR21 rifle and is intended only for playing on PVP servers. It is optimized to work without modular butts/handles and optical sights. The description of the macro is based on the use of a full clip of 60 rounds.

Before using this macro, make sure that the sensitivity in the game is set to 6 and the DPI of your mouse is in the range from 800 to 1600.
The mode of operation of this macro implies the use of a third-person sight, shooting from the hip and shooting up from the first person (it is possible to use the front sight of the sight).
For the best results, it is recommended to use modular compensators, which will reduce the randomness of the scatter and increase the accuracy of shots.
author: Keyran / Comunidade

title: FastZoomVINTOREZ
description:
IMBA (FastZoom) is a macro that allows you to quickly activate the zoom and deliver a shot or kill! It is added for a time, which means that it can be used in a certain period of time. 

If you like this macro, please like it and write in the comments if you need more macros for the game! It won't take much time, but we will be pleased!
attention: If your sight does not work correctly or it repeats after the shot, you may have incorrectly set the delay between pressing and releasing the mouse button «LMB»! It is recommended to go to training and learn how to shoot correctly!

advice: How to use a bunch of macros (FastZoom + Zoom-delay sight + Djamp at the same time!)
1. Launch two Keyran applications. On the first one, set the macro «Zoom-delay of the sight» on the mouse button «PCM».
2. On the second application, set the «Djamp» macro to the «Space» button - to jump, and set the «FastZoom» macro to the «LMB» mouse button.
3. Start the game, play from a third person and enjoy the process!

title: Auto-Djamp
description:

It is also possible to combine various macros for the convenience of the game. For example, a bunch of macros «FastZoom + Zoom-delay sight + Djamp» allows you to achieve optimal accuracy when shooting. To do this, you need to run two programs - BotMek. On the first instance of the program, set the macro «Zoom-delay sight» on the right mouse button. On the second instance, we set the «Djamp» macro to the «Space» key (jump), and the «FastZoom» macro to the left mouse button.
Thus, the player can simultaneously jump, use the sight delay and fast zoom, which greatly facilitates the gameplay and increases the shooting efficiency.

title: AK-74M

1) This macro is designed in such a way that it can be used without the need to install modular handles and compensators. Now you don't have to waste time searching for and buying them!
2) Regardless of your level of experience, this macro is suitable for both beginners and experienced fighters. So it doesn't matter how familiar you are with the game - you can use this macro with ease!
3) One of the main advantages of this macro is the lack of proclication. Now you can light the entire clip into your target without any problems, without having to make a call after each shot!

It doesn't matter what the DPI value of your mouse is - this macro will work without failures and problems.
To use a compact Scope, it is recommended to set the sensitivity in the game to 3.4.
If you prefer to use ACOG Sight, adjust the sensitivity in the game to 2.5.
For the Kobra Sight, it is recommended to set the sensitivity in the game to 1.9.

If it seems to you that your weapon is shifting down a little, try to reduce the sensitivity in the game. You always have the opportunity to adjust the sensitivity to any sights to get maximum efficiency.
Please note: the use of modular handles and compensators increases the accuracy of shooting, reducing the random deviation that is present in the game. In addition, shooting with a curse increases accuracy at long distances!

title: Farm for a Sniper
description:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------A unique macro for AFK-increasing the level of the Sniper character------------

The macro below allows you to automate the process of raising the level of the «Sniper» character in the Killing Floor game. Follow the instructions below to configure and use this macro.

--------------------------------------------------------------------Installation instructions---------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Download and install the Keyran program on your computer.
2. Open the Keyran program and download this macro.
3. Assign the desired button or key combination to activate the macro. It is recommended to use the mouse wheel or the Space bar button.
4. Start the Killing Floor game.
5. In the game settings, go to the «Parameters - Mouse» section and set the mouse sensitivity to 1.00.
6. Download the farm card with the name «TestZSpawningZoneV30ULTIMATE[SOLO]» and go to it.
7. Choose the «Sniper» class and purchase a crossbow and enough ammunition for it.
8. Go to the «Clot» spawner and stand in the white circle.
9. Aim the sight mark at the heads of the «Clot» so that with one shot from a crossbow to kill all the «Clot» in the head.
10. Press the «E» button, then use the mouse to click on the «Full Ammunition» button and press the «Esc» key to close the menu.
11. Activate the macro by pressing the button or key combination to which you assigned it, and enjoy the automatic process of raising the level of the «Sniper» character in AFK mode.

Please note that before launching the macro, you need to make sure that the game and Keyran are active in the foreground, otherwise the macro will not work.

--------------------------------------------------------------------Important tips-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- It is recommended to check the stability and reliability of this macro before using it for long periods.
- Do not forget to monitor your character's resources so as not to be without a crossbow or ammunition while using the macro.
- Check your character regularly during AFC sessions to prevent possible death or interruption of the level-up process.

Do not forget that the game window must be clearly in the center of the screen and open exactly at the specified resolution, otherwise you will have to manually adjust the offsets for the cursor, as well as the coordinates for the first inventory cell and the buttons for opening the sales menu. This high-precision macro is designed for players over the Suite and allows you to instantly perform a deadly combination of «Root and Laser». It activates the Binding skill (Q), and then the Final Burst (R) with optimized delays, which ensures that the Ultimate animation begins while the Q projectile is still in flight. description:

1. Open the macros window in the game.

3. Enter the name of the macro (for example, «Hiller»).
4. Enter the following commands:

   a) /target [character name] - this command allows you to set the target of the specified character. Replace «[character name]» with your own nickname or the nickname of the character you want to cure.

   b) /useshortcut 1 [skill number] - this command activates the Battle Heal skill using the specified number. For example, if Battle Heal is in the first place in your skill bar, then enter «/useshortcut 1».

5. Save the macro.

Now, when you press the key that this macro is linked to, your character will automatically select the specified character as a target and apply the Battle Heal skill. This ensures fast and effective hilling in combat situations.

Please note that you may need to create a separate macro for each character and their positions in the skill bar.

title: Following the main one
description:
An excellent macro for playing three windows simultaneously in Lineage 2!

1. Make sure that the windows with the game are located on the taskbar under the numbers 4, 5 and 6.

2. Window number 4 should be the main window with your character.

3. To create a macro for the characters in windows 5 and 6, enter the following commands in Lineage 2:

/target <name of your main character>
/attack

4. Go to the game settings in the «Video» section. Make sure that the «Reduce system load» option is disabled and «Use GPU» is enabled. If your computer is not very powerful, it is recommended to increase the response to a value from 125 to 250 ms.

5. Link the created macro to a button on the keyboard that is convenient for you.

6. Play with pleasure! Now you can simultaneously control all three windows of the game in Lineage 2.

id: Minecraft/1.8.9 sprint spam and 11 cps macro.amc
title: 1.8.9 sprint spam and 11 cps macro
description:
This macro is designed for a single player game in Minecraft version 1.8.9 with an emphasis on automating two repetitive actions.: activate the sprint key and perform about 11 clicks per second using the left mouse button. The main goal is to ensure that these actions are performed smoothly in the background, without affecting the player's normal mouse movement. This allows the player to continue to control the camera naturally, instead of allowing the macro to control the cursor or generate artificial mouse movements.

The first component of the macro includes activating the sprint key at a preset interval. Depending on the user's control settings, this key can be assigned to a standard sprint key or another preferred key. The repetitive input is designed to provide responsiveness to running-related actions without having to constantly press a key manually. The macro should avoid interfering with motion control, including the W, A, S, and D keys, which allows the player to maintain normal directional control during sprint automation.

The second component is responsible for automating left clicks with a target value of about 11 clicks per second. Its task is to produce a steady stream of left mouse button clicks without having to press the physical mouse button by name. Timing is an important aspect, as irregular delays can lead to significant fluctuations in the actual click rate. Therefore, the macro should use controlled click intervals to maintain a stable rate close to 11 clicks per second, rather than aiming to deliver as many clicks as possible in a short period of time.

It is extremely important that the macro does not control the mouse cursor. The user's physical mouse movement should remain completely independent of the automated click process. When the player moves the mouse, Minecraft should receive these normal movements, just like before, allowing the camera to rotate naturally in any direction. The macro should only generate a left-button click event and should not move the cursor, simulate camera movement, or make changes to the X/Y coordinates of the mouse.

In addition, the macro should allow the user to enable and disable its functions using convenient hotkeys. Ideally, sprint automation and click automation can be controlled independently of each other, allowing the user to activate only the necessary functionality at the moment. It is also useful to have a separate emergency stop key, as it provides an immediate way to stop all automated actions if the behavior becomes undesirable or the player requires full manual control.

The time should be configurable wherever possible. Although the target click rate is about 11 clicks per second, small changes are possible due to the operating system's scheduling, input processing in Minecraft, or the method of creating mouse click events. Therefore, the goal is to achieve a stable average of about 11 clicks per second, rather than claiming that exactly eleven attacks are recorded every second in Minecraft.

This macro is intended for private use in the Minecraft single player game version 1.8.9. It is a convenient automation tool for repetitive inputs, allowing you to improve the gameplay. You should not use it on multiuser servers, as automating keyboard input and clicks may violate server rules.

Finally, this macro combines the automatic activation of the sprint key with about 11 clicks per second, while maintaining full control of the player's manual mouse movement. The basic principle of development is that automation should only deal with repetitive input, while the player retains direct responsibility for controlling movement, targeting, camera rotation, and all other normal interactions in the game.

title: Melon Macro Hypixel Skyblock S-Shape
description:
The macro for watermelon farm automation, developed for the MelonKingDE project, is an effective tool for harvesting. The main length of the farm is 5 lanes, where one lane takes approximately 14,250 milliseconds. A version with water is specially provided, and there is also a possibility that the version without water will also work, although this requires verification.

The step-by-step instructions for using this macro are as follows:

1. Make sure that you have set the viewing angle for the farm correctly.:
   - The Yaw parameter must be set to 0.
   - The Pitch parameter should be 59 degrees.
   To set the desired angle, it is recommended to use the Squeaky Mousemat object.

2. Go to the beginning of the farm, stand on the first block where you will harvest, and enter the command: /sethome. This will allow you to set up a point at home for quick access to the start of work.

3. Launch the Keyran program (in my case, it's the NumPad 5 key). After activation, the program icon should change color from red to green, which indicates that it is ready for operation.

4. Link the macro to a convenient key (for example, NumPad 3) to simplify control.

5. Make sure that you have the Skyhanni mod installed, downloaded from the official GitHub repository from developer hannibal002.

6. Enter the /sh or /skyhanni command in the chat to activate the mod's functionality.

7. Open the «About» tab and use the search (magnifying glass icon) to find the «keybinds» section.

8. Go to the «Garden» menu and select «Custom Keybinds».

9. Activate the «Enabled» slider to enable custom keys.

10. Adjust the layout to your preferences, for example:
- Attack — Space / Space
- Use an object — RMB / RMB (button 2)
- Left movement — F / A
- Right movement — B/ D
- Forward movement — C/ W
- Backward movement — S / S
- Jump — LMB / LMB (button 1)
- Squat — Shift.

11. Run the /warp garden command and then press the key that the macro was linked to. The first launch will be directed to the left, the second to the right.

It is important to remember that the «Rewarp» feature was added in update 1.0.2, which automatically enters the «/warp garden» command at the end of ten lanes of your farm. For security reasons, it is not recommended to leave the macro running overnight or to work with it for more than 10 hours a day.

title: doubling items (new way)
description:
Hello, friends! I have an interesting suggestion for you — to talk about ways to duplicate items in Minecraft. You've probably already heard about dupe and how to use it, but for beginners, let's figure out what it is.

Item duplication is one of the most discussed topics in the entire Minecraft world. This is a special game with its own mechanics, and sometimes glitches occur that allow us to «double» our resources. Despite the fact that Mojang developers are trying to fix as many bugs in updates as possible, not all failures can be fixed, and version 1.21 still has para-centered and workable ways to get duplicates.

Let's look at a few of these approaches in more detail.

### 1. Dup via inventory

Duplication through inventory is one of the easiest and at the same time the most effective ways to get duplicates. The bottom line is that the game doesn't always have time to save inventory changes when you put items in storage. If you set up the rendering, simulation, and frame rate settings correctly, you can make the game run slowly, giving you the ability to quickly place multiple items in a container. Then, if you do everything right, you will still have the same item both in the container and in your inventory. This method is quite easy to use, especially if you know exactly how to set up the game.

###2. TNT Duplication

Another interesting way to duplicate is to use TNT, slugs, and pistons. These items interact with each other in such a way that you can get a much larger amount of explosives from one block. Although this method requires some care, it allows you to clear large areas or use duplicated TNT to create powerful machinery or farms.

###3. Duplicate traps

Now let's talk about duplicating traps. For this purpose, a design of hatches, pistons and armor stands is used. When you set the trap hook, it breaks at the same moment, and the game crashes, resulting in a duplicate. This is quite an interesting, albeit strange, way that can help you create various defense mechanisms or even simply replenish your stocks of duplicated traps.

###4. String duplication

A string is another object that you can easily work with. When placed on a block, it can be duplicated in large numbers. The main thing is to destroy it correctly. This resource becomes important throughout the game: metal objects, crossbows, and even wool blocks can all be created using a duplicated string.

###5. Rope duplication

Rope is another indispensable item. It is necessary to create items such as bows and fishing rods, and can also be used to create wool blocks. Getting a lot of rope opens up a lot of opportunities for you in construction and crafting, whether it's creating new paintings or using it as fuel in a furnace.

###6. Duplication through Portal gravity

This failure is due to the unique mechanics of the portal. In Minecraft, there are blocks such as sand or dragon eggs that can be duplicated if they fall through a portal under certain conditions. This method can be useful in the later stages of the game, especially when you need a lot of objects.

### Conclusion

As you can see, there are many ways to duplicate items in Minecraft. Be careful and use these methods wisely! It is important to remember that some servers may prohibit the use of similar tricks due to the balance in the game. So before deciding whether to use these tricks, read the server rules. Good luck in your adventures in the block world!

title: Dupont
description:
This dupe method is suitable for both server games and the local Minecraft network. To successfully perform this trick, you will need certain items and a little skill.:

- Two chests (to create one large chest).
- One dynamite.
- Ignition (lighter).

Follow these steps to complete the dup: 

1. Place two chests next to each other so that they form one large chest.
2. Transfer all the items you want to duplicate to this large chest.
3. Place the dynamite on the ground at some distance from the chest.
4. Hold down the dynamite and at the same time quickly press the key to which your macro is attached. Make sure that repeated keystroke is set in the settings.

After completing these steps, you will be kicked out of the game. When you come back in, check if there has been a dynamite explosion. If it did not explode, it means that the dup was successful, and your items were successfully duplicated. 

However, if the dynamite has already gone off, it means that the server has saved the data, and you will need to repeat the process again. 

Pay attention to the important delay settings between keystrokes, as this is critically important if you are playing on a server. Recommended delay values:

- 52 ms (if the Internet speed is 200 Mbit/s)
- 61 ms (at speeds from 200 to 400 Mbit/s)
- 65 ms (at speeds from 400 to 1000 Mbit/s)

To find out your internet speed, use websites such as Speedtest. Good luck in the game and successful dupes!

description:
This macro is designed to automatically assemble millet, carrots, potatoes, and growths on the Hypixel server, and it works without your participation. Here are the main points to consider:

7. **Setting the digging time**: For better performance, it is recommended to set the time delays associated with digging a single line. Pay attention to the lines where the delay exceeds 80,000 ms to eliminate unnecessary pauses.

**Important**: Please note that the macro may not work correctly at high ping or low FPS. A minimum of 60 FPS is recommended for stable operation.

title: The auto murder of Gaia
description:
This macro is designed for semi-automatic destruction of gaia, requires certain conditions to be met:
1. The operation of the Shift button should mimic the behavior in version 1.16.5 – to lower the player to the floor of the block.
2. The server must have a Gaia Killer item or a similar sword capable of destroying Gaia with one blow.

To fight Gaia, the arena must be covered with carpets and have a lighthouse on which Gaia will be placed.

For the macro to work accurately, you need to adjust the delays depending on the TPS server. The setup instructions are provided below.

How to use a macro:
1. Stand on the iron blocks and hold down the Shift to dive half a block. Hover over the lighthouse, then release Shift without focusing on the lighthouse.

Activating the macro:
1. Set up the hotbar as follows:
- First slot: Terra bars.
   - Other slots: 8 gaia assassins.

Delay setting:
1. Line 41: pause at the moment of gaia's spawn, depends on the spawn speed. It is recommended to add 5-10 seconds on servers with low TPS.
2. Line 105: Pause after gaia is destroyed, configurable depending on TPS. After this delay, the macro will start working again.

For the correct operation of the macro, it is recommended to conduct tests and adjust the delays to specific server conditions.

description:
The macro allows you to automatically sell items at auction in slots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. To use the macro, you need to follow these steps:

3. The macro will work as follows: first the 1 key will be pressed, then the «/» symbol, then the up arrow, and finally the Enter key. Then the 2 key will be pressed, then «/», then the up arrow and Enter, and so on until 9.
4. If you have problems with the macro, it is recommended to edit it as follows:
- Open the macro file and select all its contents.
   - Right-click and select the «Edit» option
   - Increase the delay for all actions in the macro, for example to 30 ms or even 40 ms. Such delays should help to avoid possible errors and failures.
   
It is important to remember that the hot bar should only contain items that you plan to sell. Do not put things valuable or personal to avoid their accidental sale. Please note that items must be placed in the hot bar manually, as not all items can be sold, and automatic placement can lead to errors.

Now that all the settings are done, you just need to activate the macro by clicking on the installed button (for example, J). description:
This script is designed for automatic crafting of Ender's enchanted eyes in the Minecraft game. They are very valuable resources, so with this script you will be able to produce them in large quantities. 

To begin with, you will need the following items: a large combat net and the same, but enchanted, ender-enchanted pearls, ordinary rods and screws. 

Next, you need to place the items on your inventory. The big combat net should be in slot 7-8, where 7 is a big combat net, and 8 is enchanted. Enchanted ender-pearls and ordinary ifrit rods should be located in slots 6 and 5, respectively. 

You will also need keybinds with commands for buttons 6 and 5. On button 6 you set the command «/craft», and on button 5 - «/bz numpad». Please note that these buttons must be different from normal buttons, for example, using NumPad.

After performing all the manipulations, you run the script and check the interface for 2 screen sizes. It is important that the resolution is 1920x1080, so that everything functions clearly and without problems.

description:
This macro is designed for use in the Minecraft game in order to prevent a kick for using cheats on servers when using a barriton. It works in about 98% of cases, although the percentage may vary depending on the server and the version of the game (I personally use it on version 1.16.5). The macro itself is short and simple, but it is enough for the full use of the barriton.

What needs to be done to make the macro function:
1. Go to the «Settings» menu during the game (on the server).
2. Open the «Management» section.
3. Scroll down to the «Miscellaneous» section, where the «Cinematographic Camera» setting is located. By default, no key is assigned to this function.
4. Assign a key for the «Cinematographic Camera» function of your choice (I usually use the F6 key, but you can choose any one that suits you).
5. Exit the settings and return to the game.

Now, when you press the key that you have assigned in the settings, a mode is activated in which your camera (what moves when the mouse moves) moves smoothly with inertia instead of sudden movements. This is what is required for the work of the barriton.

Now that you have a button assigned to activate the macro (note: make sure it turns off when you click the button again, otherwise it will not work correctly), to run it, follow these steps:

1. Turn on the recording mode in the Keyran program (red button with a triangle image at the bottom).
2. Click on the button to which you have assigned the cinematographic camera.
3. Click on the button to which you have assigned this macro.

Note: your cursor will constantly deviate from you (literally, «live your life»), so don't forget to disable the macro when you don't need it.

title: AntiAFK  for VimeWorld
description:
Anti-AFC is a method that allows a player to be in the game without the risk that the system will kick him for inactivity. It is ideal for situations where the player wants to stay in the game, but temporarily move away from the computer.

To use this method, you will need to follow several steps. First, after appearing in the game, you need to take off all personalization, such as wings, masks, hats, and so on. Then you need to head to the left of the spawn site and go down to find a block with a ladder on the floor. As soon as you do, stand on this block and take Ender's pearls. Then throw it up, above you.

After performing these actions, you will remain stuck in the block, which is the purpose of this method. Now it's the macro's turn. He will control your character, including pressing the shift key to hide you from the moderators, as well as periodically get up for 1-3 seconds so that the system does not notice that you are in AFK (inactivity) mode.
Now you can continue to stay in the game for as long as you want, even until you turn blue. However, it should be taken into account that at night the number of active players usually decreases, and there is a greater chance that you will be noticed. But this is not as critical as it seems.

Key binding: Start creating a macro by tying a left-handed punch to a specific key on the keyboard. To do this, in the first line of the macro structure, specify the key that will be used to hit the left side. For example, you can specify the «A» key as a bound key.

Impact delay: Add a delay before striking. The delay should be long enough to create a delayed impact effect. Enter the command to hold the bound key in the macro to create this delay.
Direction of attack: Set the direction of impact to the left side. Use the mouse or other keys to indicate the direction of impact in the Mordhau game. Make sure that the command to direct the attack is placed after the strike delay.

2. Go around to the marker indicating the «Tram driver». A window with the «Close» and «Work» buttons will appear on the screen.

The instructions for using the macro in such cases are as follows:

1. If you have an uncharacteristic situation or a problem in the game, stop executing the main macro if it was running.

2. Switch to manual control mode and continue to the nearest monorail station. Try to stop the train as close as possible to the column «Stop the first car». To do this, it is enough that the nose of the first car is located between this column and the beginning of the peron.

3. Open the train doors to hear the announcement of the station name.

4. Close the game and assign the desired macro from the series «Arrivals to the Depot» to the key that is convenient for you. The name of the macro can include information about the direction and the name of the station, for example: «Arrivals to the Depot Counterclockwise 1_arena_mirny-Depot». The number before the name of the station indicates the circle from which the arrival begins: the first or second, respectively.

5. Start the game and activate the assigned macro. The macro will automatically close the doors and continue along the route to the Depot.

Notes on using this macro:

1. It is recommended to run the macro with minimal graphics settings with a resolution of 1366x768x32. This will help to avoid possible problems with the display of the game and increase the stability of the macro.

2. The macro provides for random pauses before opening and closing doors, as well as before the train starts moving. This will help make the macro work more realistic and prevent errors.

3. Long delays at stations in the macro allow you to avoid (although they do not guarantee) skipping stations with an unstable connection to the server.

4. When you start the macro, it will independently drive the remaining section of the way to the Depot and will automatically end. After that, you can take up the driver's job again and re-run the macro.

However, the following important points should be taken into account:

1. The use of this macro is at your own risk. Remember that the administrators of the game monitor this kind of automation and can apply appropriate measures. Please use the macro responsibly and follow the rules of the game.

2. It is recommended not to leave the computer for a long time when the macro is running in order to be prepared for possible emergency situations or requests from administrators.

This macro will greatly facilitate your work and will allow you to move almost perfectly between the columns and stop at the «stop of the first car». We also promise to provide you with other macros for trips to the Depot of the monorail in the future.

title: containers stress test
description:
This macro is designed to automatically bet on containers on the MTA Province server during stress testing. 
First, the cursor must be placed on the bid entry field. Next, using the left mouse button, you need to select the current bet and then enter eight nines. In this case, the current bet is automatically deleted and replaced with a new symbol 9. Then the cursor moves to the «bet» button and it is automatically pressed.

To start the macro, you need to assign it to a convenient key and run it after the trading start timer expires (usually this happens at 00:00). This allows you to have a better chance of success with your bet. However, it should be borne in mind that if a new cheat is used, for example, a kraymhak, the bid can be substituted even before the start of trading.

This macro has several limitations. Firstly, it is edited under the Keyran rules and has a delay of 1ms for each action and a pixel of mouse displacement. This may cause the macro to run slower than it could. However, you can still speed up the macro by changing the delay to zero or another value. Secondly, the macro was created for a screen resolution of 1600 by 900 and may not work on displays of a different resolution. Finally, the macro will only work if the mouse precisely hits the «bet» button and the field for entering the bet. To do this, you need to move the game window to the right place.

In general, this macro is a fairly effective tool that can significantly increase your chances of success when betting on containers in the MTA Province. However, be aware of all its limitations and use it only in accordance with the legislation and the rules of the server.

title: MU AutoReset 3 windows
description:
Before using this macro in the MU Online game, you need to make sure that the following conditions are met:
1. The version of the game must support a simplified mode, which is activated using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+F.
2. The server should be able to reset the character on the spot, that is, restore his position after death.
3. After the character is reset, there should be no automatic reconnection, that is, reconnection to the game server.
4. The macro should not affect the distribution of character characteristics, since its main function is to automate the cutting process.

To configure the window before using the macro, it is recommended to perform the following actions:
1. Bind a command to the Alt + 1 keyboard shortcut to perform a character reset, for example, entering the command «/ 1 / reset». This must be done for each of the three open windows of the game.
2. Make sure that windows other than the windows of the MU Online game are closed or minimized so that when switching windows using Alt+Tab keyboard shortcuts, the macro is not activated in other applications.
3. Before running the macro, make sure that all open windows of the game are in simplified mode, which is activated by pressing Ctrl+F.

Description of the macro operation:
The macro performs the following sequence of actions:
1. Removes the simplified mode of the game window using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+F.
2. Presses the keyboard shortcut Alt + 1, which was assigned to the character's reset command.
3. Sets the simplified mode on the game window using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+F.
4. Switches to the next game window.
5. Performs the same sequence of actions on this window.
6. Switches to the third game window.
7. Performs the same sequence of actions on this window.
8. Returns the focus to the first game window.
9. Waits for one minute.
10. Repeats the entire sequence of actions from the beginning.

Thus, the macro automatically cuts the character on each of the three windows of the MU Online game, removing and setting the simplified mode, and then switching between windows and repeating the process. A minute's pause after completing all the actions allows the character to recover and prepare for the next flight.

It is important to remember that this macro is intended only for the MU Online game and can only be used in accordance with the terms and conditions of the server.

title: The difference in the flow of DUT
description:
Hello! This macro is designed to work with multiple composite sensors in FORT Monitor and simplifies the process of configuring them. Here are the basic steps you need to follow:

1. For the equipment, create two sensors that record the difference in fuel consumption, with the names «Difference in fuel consumption 1» and «Difference in fuel consumption 2».
   1.1. The first sensor (DT1) is created based on the LLS1 parameter.
   1.2. The second sensor (DT2) is installed using the LLS2 parameter.
   1.3. Then universal sensors are created that calculate the «difference from the previous value» for LLS1 and LLS2.
   1.4. At this stage, you need to create an event called «DUT Difference».

2. Next, create a composite sensor called «Flow Difference» in the «Composite Sensors» section.

3. After that, copy the created composite sensor to all the objects that you plan to monitor (this can be done through the object editor).

description:
This macro is a little more difficult to use than the previous ones, so you need to carefully familiarize yourself with its functionality.

This macro is based on a double click: in the Perfect World game, if you double-click on a character from your party, all your twins will start following him. It is important to note that if you are using the game version 1.6.2 or later, your twins will follow you even while flying and raise their altitude according to the leader of the group. However, if you have version 1.5.5 or older, this option will not be available — the twins will simply follow the ground. In this case, it is recommended to first take to the air and set the desired height, and only then activate the macro.

After logging into the game, set up all the game windows so that the icons of the party participants are located in the same areas on each window. Then, first of all, click on the character who is at the top of your group's list, as he will always be your leader.

To activate the following, double-click on the leader of the group, and your twins will immediately start moving towards him.

When setting up the macro button, choose the one that is convenient for you. Personally, I use the V button for this purpose. 

Don't forget to check the version and follow the instructions to achieve the best results.

id: Ragnarok Online/Arch Bishop Max Skill Loop.amc
title: Arch Bishop Max Skill Loop
description:
### A Complete Guide to Macros for Automating Arch Bishop Support in Ragnarok Online

This macro is designed specifically for Arch Bishops in the game Ragnarok Online, in order to automate the process of using important auxiliary skills during training or combat. It provides continuous buffs without the need to manually activate skills, which greatly improves the efficiency of the game and supports uninterrupted assistance to the team.

Thanks to the automated process, your character will follow the group members non-stop, even after applying buffs. This is especially useful if you use an auxiliary priest, as it removes the need to manually select the main character after each use of the skill.

---

### Key Features:

1. **Automatic Support for Co-Partners**: The macro automatically applies all critical support skills in a preset sequence.

2. **Optimized Timing**: The duration of each skill is synchronized to ensure continuous action, even for short-duration buffs such as Gloria.

3. **Uninterrupted Repetition**: The macro repeats the entire sequence of buffs as soon as the longest buff expires, for example, Clementia, providing continuous assistance to the team.

4. **Customizable Configuration**: Despite the preset macro for optimal use, users can change the skill sequence or time intervals according to their preferences.

---

### Setting Up Skills and Keys:

- **Q** - Suffagium [Level 3]
- **W** - Impositio Manus [Level 3]
- **E** - Magnificat [Level 5]
- **R** - Cantocandidus [Level 3]
- **T** - Clementia [Level 3]
- **Y** - Praefatio [Level 5]
- **J** - Renovatio [Level 2]
- **S** - Gloria [Level 3]

---

### How The Macro Works:

1. **Skill Activation**:
The macro triggers the skills in a preset sequence based on the assigned keys. Each skill is applied at carefully selected time intervals to provide stable support for both short and long buffs.

2. **Priority of Gloria and Suffragium**:
Short-term skills such as Gloria (S key) and Suffragium (Q key) have a higher priority and are applied multiple times during the same cycle to maintain their effect.

3. **Full Cycle Execution**:
The macro completes the full cycle of applying buffs, ending with the longest-term skill, Clementia (T key). As soon as Clementia expires, the whole process starts over automatically.

4. **Automatic Team Following**:
When used with a supporting priest or main character, the macro ensures that your Arch Bishop continues to follow the team without manual adjustment after applying buffs.

---

### Step-By-Step Instructions:

1. **Assign Skills**:
Assign skills to the corresponding keys in the quick access toolbar according to the table above.

2. **Macro Configuration**:
Assign a hotkey to start the macro.

3. **Repeat Mode Setting**:
Make sure that the macro is running in «Repeat Mode» for continuous execution.

4. **Screen Settings**:
Set the game resolution to 1600 x 900 for optimal game window location.

5. **Window Positioning**:
Move the Ragnarok Online window to the upper-left corner of your screen.

6. **Time Settings**:
If you change skill levels or their duration, adjust the macro intervals accordingly. For example:
- If Gloria is at level 5 (duration 30 seconds), set the interval to 20-25 seconds for overlay.
   - For Clementia at level 5, increase the interval slightly for smooth looping.

7. **Startup and Fun**:
Run the macro and it will track all the tasks for applying buffs, allowing you to focus on the gameplay.

---

### Key Advantages:

1. **Improved Team Efficiency**: Provides continuous support to the entire group, maximizing their performance during fights and training.

2. **Precise Timing**: A carefully thought-out application procedure eliminates pauses between buffs, maintaining optimal efficiency throughout the game.

3. **Customizable**: Adapts easily to different skill settings and game styles, making it versatile for different team compositions and strategies.

4. **Effortless Automation**: Allows you to focus on gameplay and strategy without worrying about manually repeating buffs.

5. **Reliable Performance**: Guarantees continuous following of the team and application of skill, even in the conditions of intense and fast fights.

---

### Thanks:

Many thanks to the Keyran team for revolutionizing the way we play Ragnarok Online!

With this macro, the tedious task of re-applying the Gloria skill becomes easier, giving players more time to enjoy the game.

---

If you need any changes or additional details, let us know!

title: Gloria Auto Skill Loop
description:
Macro Name: Eternal Blessing – Automation of the Gloria Boost

Goal:
The Gloria skill is an important feature in Ragnarok Online, providing a significant improvement in the form of +30 LUC (Agility) both Custer and all the members of his group. This characteristic is crucial for many aspects of the game, including:

- Critical Attacks: Increases the probability of successful critical hits.
- Accuracy: Increases the chances of hitting the target.
- Physical and Magical Damage: Increases total damage.
- Evasion: Increases the chance of avoiding enemy attacks.
- Crafting Success: Improves the chances of crafting potions, crafting items, and other skills that depend on the BOW.

However, the short duration of the skill (30 seconds at the fifth level) makes it difficult to use it continuously during an intense game. This macro automates this procedure, ensuring a constant state of Gloria, with an interval of 20 seconds when set at level 3. You can adjust the interval depending on your skill level.

Supported character classes:
- The Acolyte
- The Priest
- The High Priest
- The Archbishop
- The Cardinal

Skill Details
: Skill Name: Gloria  
Key assignment: S  
Interval at 3: 20 seconds (recommended)  
Duration at 5: 30 seconds  

Effect : Increases the LUK by 30 for all group members within the range.

Optimal game scenarios:
- Teamwork: Extremely important for parties that rely on critical attacks, high accuracy, and successful item creation.
- PvP and Guild: Critical for damage sets, providing constant critical hits and evasion.
- Boss Hunting and Raids: Increases the effectiveness of both attacking and supporting roles, maximizing the potential for critical damage.
- Crafting Sessions: Perfect for Alchemists, Blacksmiths, and other classes that need to increase their BOW to craft items.

Technical settings:
Screen resolution:
Set the resolution to 1600 x 900 for precise macro alignment.  

Placement of the game window:
Place the Ragnarok Online window in the upper-left corner of the screen to correctly identify the skill panels and visualize the group.

Skill Setup:
Assign the Gloria skill to the S key in the Quick Access toolbar.

Setting up a macro in Keyran:
- Upload the macro to Keyran.
- Assign a hotkey for the macro.
- Set the operation mode to «Run Indefinitely» with a skill interval of 20 seconds for level 3. When using other levels, adjust the interval according to the duration of your Gloria skill.

Macro behavior:
After activation, the macro will be:
- Reapply Gloria every 20 seconds (or your preferred interval) to ensure continuous action.
- Automatically monitor the status of the skill, ensuring that there are no interruptions in the boost for you and your group.
- Work seamlessly in the background, allowing you to focus on healing, attacking, or managing other tasks.

Advanced Features:
- Setting the interval: Adjust the reuse interval depending on your Gloria skill level (for example, 15 seconds for level 2, 25 seconds for level 4).
- Group Range Detection: Automatically checks if all group members are within range before applying.
- Awareness of the recharge time: Prevents the macro from reactivating too early, while maintaining the efficiency of using SP.

Future updates:
- Multi-buff Integration: Combine Gloria with other supportive beats such as Blessing and Increase Agility to optimize the entire band.
- Dynamic Group Synergy: Prioritization of LUK boosts for craft or mission-critical builds.

Acknowledgements:
Thank you so much, Keyran, for revolutionizing our gaming experience at Ragnarok Online! With this macro, routine tasks such as reapplying Gloria become not an obstacle, but an additional opportunity, allowing players to enjoy the gameplay more.

description:
This macro facilitates access to the developer mode, which allows you to view all the bosses of the RAID: Shadow Legends game.

Using this macro allows you to significantly simplify and speed up the farming of scrolls in the minotaur maze, as well as to get a significant profit per night in the form of about 2 million silver and a full collection of scrolls for a fighter, if there are three characters in a team of four with a full set of scrolls.

description:
### Step 1 – Preparation

1. Set the resolution of the Rappelz game to 1024×768.

3. Open the inventory and make sure that its position is also in the upper-left corner without any displacement.

5. Go to the «Equipment» tab.

### Step 2 – Macro Operation 

####A) Automatic disassembly 

The macro automatically performs the dismantling of all steel objects. 

**Work area:**

- Start from the 4th row of the inventory.
- Start from the 3rd cell (column 3).
- Ignore the following areas:
- Rows 1 through 3.
- The first two cells in the 4th row.

After that, the macro will continue to dismantle cell by cell, following the established order.

####B) Automatic equipment sorting 

The macro performs regular sorting of items on the inventory, which allows:

- Always keep the equipment at the top of the list.
- Avoid shifting objects after each disassembly.

This ensures the stability of the coordinates and minimizes the chance of errors when clicking.

### Additional tips

- After setting up, make sure that all the interface elements are correctly positioned and do not overlap each other so that the macro works smoothly.
- Carefully check that all settings are saved to avoid unexpected situations during the game.
- Update the macro regularly if changes in the game or updates to the Keyran program affect its functionality.

Following these steps, you can easily automate the dismantling process, optimizing time and increasing efficiency in the game.

description:
Improved version of the «BPF WASD» macro

Based on the basic macro «Big Place Farming» from the Keyran program, I made several changes to adapt it to my goals. The result is a very convenient and versatile script that is suitable for many tasks in the game Rappelz.

Description of macro actions:
The macro sequentially presses the W, A, S, D keys to allow the character to move around in a circle and select all mobs in a given location. The macro also uses keys from 1 to 0 to perform various actions, such as using skills or lifting a drop.

Scope of application:
This macro is ideal for farming on Foggy Island, as well as for circular farms in master class areas. It also works great in all dungeons with dragons and in any other place where mobs are present and where your character is able to survive.

Using a macro:

1. Set the auto-attack for the pet to button 1.
2. Install the necessary self-buffs, treatment and other skills on the keys from 2 to 0.

The macro is highly configurable and can use a large number of keys. If you don't need all the buttons, just leave them blank. Personally, I use all 10 keys.

Some tips and tricks when using this macro:

1. Move the camera away from the character to have a bigger view and see all the mobs around. This will help to avoid missing valuable goals. If you need to move the camera further away than the game allows, you can find guides on YouTube about editing camera files in the Rappelz/cams folder.
2. You can assign materials such as iron and steel from the character's backpack to the keys 8 and 9 respectively. Thus, the macro will automatically combine these materials, and your character will be able to continue farming continuously without overloading. This will allow you to collect more drops and freely spend more time in the game.
3. If your character is too weak and has difficulty killing mobs, you can assign to the button, for example, 3 the use of your pet's ability, which will heal your character. This way, your character will not die from mobs, and you will be able to stay alive in a place where you would normally die.
4. You can run this macro on a virtual machine, and it will work perfectly, farming and pumping your character, allowing you to use the computer for other tasks, such as work or watching a movie.

The screen resolution on which this macro was tested and worked out: 1920*1080, 1163*864, 1366*768. However, I am sure that this macro will work on any resolution at which you run the game Rappelz.

Special thanks to the creator of the macro «Big Place Farming» and the KEYRAN team for the opportunity to use this tool!

description:
The macro, designed to simplify the process of improving Cooking skills in the game Red Dead Redemption 2, significantly speeds up the filling of empty bottles. You will need a lot of water to make soups successfully, and to save money, it is better to buy empty bottles and fill them yourself. It will cost you $1.5 cheaper than buying water bottles.

The procedure for using a macro is as follows:

1. Approach a water source, be it a sink or a water column, so that it is in the center of your screen.
2. Run a macro that will automatically fill the bottles with water until all of them run out in your inventory.

It is important to remember that for the macro to work successfully, you need to set the resolution of your screen and game to 1920 x 1080 pixels.

If you want to use the macro at a different screen resolution, follow these steps:

1. Stand next to a column or sink and hold down the Alt key, then click on the water source to open the context menu.
2. In the KeyRan application, drag the sight icon to the «Fill bottle» item in this menu to get the necessary coordinates.
3. Open the macro editor and find the 7th row with coordinates.
4. Right-click on this line and select the «Edit» option.
5. Enter the previously obtained coordinates (X and Y) in the appropriate fields.
6. Run the macro and switch to the game window to activate it. 

Now enjoy the simplicity of leveling up your cooking skills!

title: evade emote + jump
description:
Don't know how to perform an emotion dash or an emotion hop in a Roblox game? If your goal is to jump with emotion across the map without delay, then this guide is designed just for you.

This guide is specifically designed for hop implementation, while a separate version will be provided for the standard desh. So, follow the steps below to master the skill you need.

1. Set up the macro with keyboard shortcuts. It is advisable to choose the keys located next to the main ones, such as W, A, S, D. I recommend using the Russian letter «U» and the English «E», but you can adjust any other keys at your discretion (for example, R, Z, X, V).

2. Start running.

3. Many gamers advise not to squat down and not to pick up utilities. Just press the key that you previously blocked.

4. At the moment, your emotion is activated. Be sure to place an emotion that can move in the 4th slot so that it doesn't stay in place.

5. Since this version includes jumping, you will not need to constantly press the space bar to jump — the macro will do this task for you.

6. Don't forget that this is only suitable for PCs and laptops. As soon as you activate the macro, remove your finger from the W key if you were moving forward.

7. Emotion hop is that you will move from side to side, while using emotion to jump.

8. The main keys for operation are A and D. No more pressing the space bar is required!

9. When you have activated an emotion and start to smoke, it is important to press the A and D keys every 30 ms.

10. If you don't press these keys often enough, the hop won't work — this is a critical point that needs to be considered.

In short:

- Bind to R
- Emotion in 4 slots
- Spam the A and D keys
- Turn the camera from side to side

Congratulations, now you can do hop! If the instructions get a lot of views, I will release a lite version. This may seem like a simple instruction, but many people are wondering, «How do I do this?!»

description:
Decaying Winter is an FPS game based on the Roblox platform, where you and a team of four players need to survive for ten nights, each of which becomes more difficult. To successfully perform this maneuver, high precision is required, down to milliseconds, which makes the task extremely difficult.

To simplify this process, we have created a special macro. 

Instructions for use:
- Prepare the steam you want to use and activate the macro by pressing a preset key or by delaying activation.

Recommendations:
- Do not set the hotkey for this macro to keys that are already performing any actions in the game. We recommend using the Y, G, or U keys as hotkeys.
- If you need to specify how long it takes to use each type of steam, refer to the Decaying Winter wiki page.

If you have any questions, suggestions, or other comments, do not hesitate to contact the developer of this macro (me) using the built-in Keyran messenger.

description:
Are you looking to optimize your gaming experience in Roblox Demon Slayer: Midnight Sun and provide yourself with an additional supply of breath without having to constantly press keys? It works as follows: after a certain time, the G key is pressed to fill the breath counter, and then the left mouse button is simulated to blow the pumpkin. This cycle repeats until you decide to stop it.

This macro is useful for players who want to increase the capacity of their breath reserve. Moreover, it will allow you to save time and energy by taking on all the routine actions. Our macro is easily configured to work with any style of breathing, be it water, flame, thunder or fog.

To use this macro, you will need to download it from our website and run it on your computer. Then you will need to open the game Roblox Demon Slayer: Midnight Sun and go to the merchant inside the game world. Usually the trader is on spawn near one of the walls. Please note that this macro is specially designed to work at the third stage of the merchant.

After buying the last pumpkin, find a safe place and activate the macro by pressing F1 or another key that you have assigned. The macro will automatically start the process of filling and blowing air into the pumpkin. While the macro takes over all the routine actions, you can enjoy the beauty of the game world, move freely and even do external things without looking up from the computer. To stop the macro, just click on the same button that you used to activate.

It is important to note that this macro is completely safe and will not be detected by the game developers. It does not make changes to game files or settings, but rather simulates keyboard actions allowed by the game. However, be sure to use the macro in safe areas so as not to put your character in danger or lose the pumpkin.

If you liked our macro and it turned out to be useful for you, please tell your friends about it inside the game. We hope that our macro will help you enjoy Roblox Demon Slayer: Midnight Sun even more!

Thank you for using our macro and wish you a successful game in Roblox Demon Slayer: Midnight Sun!

title: A monkey In the bottom layer!
description:
The macro «Master angler» for the game «Russian Fishing 4» is designed for convenient and automated fishing. It is very easy to install it through the Keyran program, which will significantly improve your gaming experience.

Before using the macro, it is recommended to make sure that the screen resolution is 1920x1080. For proper operation, it is necessary to be on the bow of the boat and direct the area of appearance of the fish icon towards the black parts of the boat. Do not change the color values inside the macro.

The macro is running continuously, so it is recommended that you first make sure that it is not. To do this, you can configure the computer to turn off automatically. It greatly simplifies fishing, especially for small fish.

To set up the macro, measure the time of lowering the bait to the desired depth. Multiply this time by 1000, divide by 200 and replace the number of repetitions in the macro. This will adjust the fishing depth.

To adjust the rewind time after lowering, change the value in the corresponding line to the required time in milliseconds.

By default, the keys are used (LMB+PCM+Shift) for vyvazhivaniye. Remove unnecessary keys (RMB in one line and Shift in another).

It is possible to set up a Late Gathering. Place the bait at the desired depth and set the coordinates on the spool fill icon. You can change the macro to take all the fish.

Explanations of some terms are also provided to understand the process of the game.

If you have any questions, you can contact us via private messages on the website. I wish you successful fishing and success on the water!
author: Keyran / Comunidade
fileName: A monkey In the bottom layer!.amc

title: TopPilking
description:
This macro is designed for easy fishing in the game. First, make sure that your screen resolution is 1920 x 1080. For the macro to work correctly, stand on the bow of the boat and point the area where the fish icon appears towards the black parts of the boat. Do not change the color values in the macro lines.

The macro won't stop when the tank is full, so make sure you're not there in advance. You can set the PC to turn off automatically for this purpose. The macro is designed to simplify your game, especially on small fish.

To set up the macro, stand at the fishing spot and measure the time of lowering the bait to the desired depth. Multiply this time by 1000, then divide by 200 and replace the result in line 7 of the macro. This will adjust the fishing depth.

To adjust the rewinding time after lowering, change the value in line No. 9 to the required time in milliseconds.

Pilking is controlled by line 17, where pilking is performed by default with the Shift key held down. The number of repetitions affects the time when the PCM is pressed. Delete lines (#13 and #19) if Shift is not required. The waiting time between PCM presses is set in line No. 22.

By default, the keys (LMB+) are used to displayPCM+Shift). Delete any unnecessary key (RMB in No. 29 and No. 43, Shift in No. 31 and No. 41).

It is possible to set up a Late Gathering in line No. 77. Place the bait at the desired depth and set the coordinates on the spool fill icon. You can change the macro to take all the fish by deleting lines No. 44 to No.56.

Information about some terms:
- PC - your computer;
- Fish icon - bite indicator;
- Quick Exit - exit immediately after pressing the LMB;
- Late Gathering - gathering after vyvazhivaniye;
- Small fish - unable to unwind your line quickly.

If you need help, please contact us via private messages on the website https://keyran.net/forum/profile/38203-u1trateam /. Good luck fishing and good luck on the water!

title: Auto Upgrade Pablo
description:
A macro for automatic updates to the stone in the Rust game

Setup: Make sure that the hammer is located on the quick access toolbar in the specified slot (by default, slot 4 in this macro).

Goal: Move the mouse pointer over the building element that you want to improve to stone (for example, walls, foundations or ceilings). 

Running a macro: Activate the macro. The script will perform the following steps:
1. Equip you with a hammer.
2. Opens the improvements menu by right-clicking on the item.
3. Moves the cursor to select the «Upgrade to Stone» option.
4. Confirms the selection to apply the update.

Repeat: If several elements need to be improved, just continue executing the macro or restart it as you move on to the next object.

Requirements:
1. Screen Resolution: This macro is optimized for a resolution of 1920x1080. If you have a different resolution, make changes to the mouse coordinates in the macro to select the menu correctly.
2. Hammer position: By default, the hammer should be in slot 4 of the quick access toolbar. Change this in the macro script if your hammer is in a different slot. 

With this macro, the improvement process will become simple and fast!

title: Python low sens + wide screen
description:
Description: This macro is designed specifically for use in the game Rust with a Python revolver at a resolution of 1080x1080. It is designed for players who prefer low mouse sensitivity. The resolution of 1080x1080 allows you to see enemy models on a wide screen, simplifying aiming and increasing the probability of hitting. The macro is optimized to take advantage of this and is ideal for those players who want to improve their shooting accuracy with Python using advanced opponent models. The accuracy of this macro ranges from 85% to 95% of hits. It can be used with both automatic fire and single shots.

Advantages of 1080x1080 resolution:
- Extended models of opponents: Opponents seem to be wider than the erleichtert die Zielerfassung.
- Improved distance estimation: A large-format image helps to better estimate the distance to the target.
- Optimization for close combat: It is suitable for shooting at medium and short distances, where every hit is important.

Activation instructions:
1. Create a custom resolution of 1080x1080 in the settings of your graphics card or processor (it does not take much time and there are guides on the Internet).
2. Set the DPI value to 400 for improved control and accuracy.
3. Open the Rust startup options and enter « -window-mode exclusive» (without quotes).
4. Launch the game, change the permission to the one you created and apply the changes.
5. Open the console in the game.
6. Enter the input.sensitivity 0.25 command to set the standard sensitivity optimized for widescreen resolution.
7. Enter the command input.ads_sensitivity 0.51 to set the sensitivity when aiming, taking into account the characteristics of the resolution and weapon.
8. Activate the macro before using Python in the game.

You can also watch a video demonstrating the use of this macro at the following link: https://youtu.be/ofYQVD_bawk .

title: ![7helpers] AssaultRifle
description:
This macro is intended for use in the Rust game with Assault Rifle. It offers several binds that allow the player to increase their accuracy and comfort of the game. 

The first bind, bind Mouse0, allows the player to turn on the laser when shooting, if it is installed. This helps the player to aim accurately and understand where his aiming point is.
The second bind, bind 7, allows the player to change the sensitivity of the mouse for comfortable shooting with a homemade sight. This can be useful in order to accurately shoot with various types of weapons, especially if it does not have a standard sight.
The third bind, bind 8, allows the player to change the sensitivity of the mouse for comfortable shooting with a standard front sight. It can also be useful in order to shoot accurately with a weapon that has a standard sight, but may require a certain mouse sensitivity.
The fourth bind, bind 9, allows the player to change the sensitivity of the mouse for comfortable shooting with a collimator sight. Collimator sight can be difficult for some players, so changing the sensitivity of the mouse can help them shoot more accurately.
The last bind, bind 0, allows the player to change the sensitivity of the mouse for comfortable shooting with an 8x sight. The 8x sight can be useful when shooting at long distances, but may also require changing the sensitivity of the mouse for accurate aiming.

It is important to note that all binds must be entered individually via the game console on F1. These binds will help players improve their accuracy and comfort of playing with Assault Rifle in Rust.

1. Install the LDPlayer emulator and set it to a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080 in full-screen mode.

3. Add commands to move the cursor to certain places on the screen to drain barrels and transform them into fragments of stars. For example, you can use the command «Move the cursor to the coordinates (x, y)» to move the cursor to the line with barrels.

5. Add commands to convert merged barrels into fragments of stars.

title: Left sa2 H
description:
Tactics for attacking from a standing strong blow (st.HP) in the corner against the characters: RY, YU, GO, OR, DU (sitting), UR (sitting), CH, IB, EL, MA, SE, TW, KE, AL, YA.

To perform combinations, use the following keys: 
- ASD (left, down, right and up)
- uiop (weak, medium and strong kick, as well as a 3-punch macro)
- jkl; (weak, medium and heavy kick, as well as a 3-kick macro)

Let's analyze the use of a special SAII strike (Abare Tosanami):

**Input combinations:**
Keep in mind that the choice of kick affects the trajectory of the SAII. Using a light leg (LK) allows you to attack almost vertically, the medium (MK) covers half the screen, and the heavy (HK) reaches 3/4 of the screen. Some characters may require a specific approach. For example, in the case of tall characters, you can use a medium or heavy punch to reach them when you are in a corner. However, for lower characters like Makoto, you will have to resort to a light punch if they are trapped in a corner, since the average one will not be able to reach.

The following combinations are possible after performing a Karakusa or a strong hit (HP), but only if the opponent remains on your half of the screen after pushing away.

1. MP Oroshi, SAII — performed under the same conditions.

**Further combinations after completion of SAII:**
It is important to remember that all actions using dash must be performed in the direction in which the enemy was affected. This means that if you activated SAII from the right corner, you should double-dash to the left, and vice versa. Also, all subsequent upper strokes (fukiage) are performed in the opposite direction from the direction of the dash.

- (Dash Castle) HP Fukiage, (Jump-cancel Up) HP
- (Dash Castle) Kara-Fukiage, (Dash Castle) Fukiage
- (Jump-cancel Directionally) MK Tsurugi, LP Hayate, HP Hayate
- (Jump-cancel Directionally) MK Tsurugi, HP Hayate, HP or HK (only in the corner)
- (Jump-cancel Directionally) MK Tsurugi, SAII, (Jump-cancel Up) MK Tsurugi, HP Hayate, HP Hayate (in the corner, requires 2 full reserves, exact time)

Some actions may be specific to certain characters, and it is also worth considering that the second fukiage can sometimes be performed through the kara method, rather than the first.

id: Terraria/Fast construction of platforms to the left.amc
title: Fast construction of platforms to the left
description:
This macro is designed to build a road from platforms, which can be useful, for example, when laying a road through the entire map in the game Terraria.

Before using the macro, it is important to make sure that all accessories and armor that increase the hero's movement speed are removed.

To use the macro, follow these instructions:
1. Stand at a distance of 5 blocks from the edge and look in the direction in which the road will be built (for example, to the left).
2. Move the cursor to the place where the blocks will be installed (5 blocks to the left of your current position).
3. Start the macro by pressing the assigned key and turn it off when it is no longer needed.

The macro timings were perfectly matched to achieve the highest construction speed.

Note: If you fall down from the road during construction, it means that you did not move far enough from the edge before turning on the macro. Make sure you are at the right distance from the edge before starting construction.

To do this, you will need a summoner and several creatures previously summoned to the battlefield. Then, perform the following bug with a party girl: buy and throw 1000 beach balls in a closed room. title: Magic
description:
IMPORTANT: before you start, you should install and enable the driver in the program. It is also recommended to enable incognito mode for additional security (the program has not been tested without this mode). 

So let's get started. 

1. Download and install the required application on your device.
2. Open the application and assign a key that you will use in the game for casting spells.
3. Next, assign a repeat when you press this key and disable the repeat when you press it again.
4. Now start the game.

description:

Perfect Weave eliminates errors and reduces the impact of ping delays on your game by 99%. This is really an invaluable help.
The following actions are defined inside the macro:
- Light attack - the «e» key
- Skill 1 - the «1» key
- Skill 2 - the «2» key

Each key is pressed three times, this is how the Perfect Weave addon algorithm works. You can reduce the delays between taps if you have a very good ping. I left a value of 64 ms, which works for me. The main thing is not to reduce the number of clicks (for example, from three to two) in order to increase damage. Instead, trust Keyran, it will cope, otherwise the PW addon may make a mistake - it has been verified. I also recommend not to link the light attack to the mouse, since the addon does not work with this key for some reason.

The Perfect Weave addon has two modes - «light» and «hard». I recommend choosing the «hard» mode, since Keyran will completely cope with the function of this mode. I wish you good luck and victories in the vastness of the game in Cyrodiil and the Imperial City!

title: Quick loot - 10 times
description:
Macro for The Witcher 3 game (The Witcher 3), created for a more convenient farming loot. By pressing the key, 10 loot picks will be made, which will greatly simplify the process of collecting resources during game farming. At the same time, after activating the macro, your character will continue to move, allowing you to collect loot without having to stop.

It is recommended to use this macro together with another macro «Automeditation - 1 hour» for more effective farming of pigs in the Wild Garden. Here are the detailed instructions for use:

1. Enter the pen with the pigs.
2. Use the sign «Igni» to kill pigs.
3. Without stopping to collect loot, activate the macro «Automeditation - 1 hour».
4. After the meditation ends, use the sign «Igni» again.
5. Continue slaughtering pigs until they completely disappear from the game world.
6. Collect all the loot using this macro and move on to the next pigs, repeating the process starting from point 1.

To use the macro, follow these steps:

1. Start the game.
2. Run the Keyran program.
3. Go to the «Keys» tab in Keyran and assign this macro to the key you need. For example, you can use the «CAPS LOCK» key or additional mouse keys.

Using the macro is very simple: just click on the appropriate button, and your character will automatically perform loot selection, making your farm more efficient and convenient.

title: TilesSurvive_Auto_Raid
description:
Launch the game on your PC, enter the wildlands, select the desired infection level and return to the wildlands. Next, run the macro. The macro clicks on the «Magnifying glass icon», then on «Search», after «Raid», then «Send», repeats these actions 5 times and waits for the end of the raids. After that, it starts a new pack of raids until you collect 95 chests, after which the macro stops (after 99 chests disappear).

For a high-quality macro to work, you need:

At 1920×1080 resolution, stretch the game window from the upper-left corner (2 mm margin) to the bottom of the taskbar (also 2 mm margin).

Fix the mouse dragging coordinates to match your values.
Otherwise, the macro won't hit the buttons.

It is also important that no one searches for infected people in parallel with you, otherwise there is a risk of sending a squad to an infected person who is already being attacked by an ally's squad. Then a pop-up window will pop up, which will interfere with the operation of the macro. Just close it.

title: Afk Pharm
description:
For effective farming of resources, you will need to use the «Master Rings» in the amount of two pieces, as well as an accessory called the «Amulet of Sacrifice», which will gradually take away your health. It is also important to use items that increase the experience gained, but do not increase the protection of your character. 

The pharma process is carried out in Greece, in the city of Knossos, where you are heading to the «Labyrinth of Minos». When you reach the third fountain, you bind yourself to it, then remove all the basic items of equipment and put on the rings of the «Ring of the Master» in combination with the «Amulet of Sacrifice». After this point, you should immediately teleport by pressing the K button. 

It is important to consider the following points:
1. You must have at least 66 levels to use the rings.
2. It is necessary to have debuffs in the «Temple of the Heavenly Agreement» in the city of Gelos in Greece.
3. The total amount of health should not exceed 17,500.
4. The movement speed of your character should be exactly 118%.
5. Farming is carried out at a higher difficulty level.
6. Cold resistance should not be lower than -180%.
7. Your character's protection should not exceed 0.
8. Use 1600x900 resolution in full-screen mode for optimal results. 

Follow these instructions and enjoy the result!

This macro is linked to the Mouse Button 4 and is designed to quickly send a C key press, which is responsible for squatting in the game Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege. When holding down the side mouse button, the macro forces the player operator to repeatedly squat and rise at a high and stable speed.

In Siege, a similar technique is used in close encounters to make it difficult for an opponent to hit the head by constantly changing the height of the operator's hitbox. In addition, random squatting helps to confuse the enemy during sorties or aggressive attacks. This macro allows the player to execute this strategy without having to manually press the squat key, while maintaining control over aiming and shooting.

This marker provides a mechanical advantage, reducing the physical strain of repetitive squatting and providing smoother and faster reactions in combat.

You can snap it to any button, but I recommend using the side mouse button. Set up the macro to hold down the button and enjoy the game!

This macro is designed so that you can completely empty the store without losing control, even on a small mouse surface.
