Before using the macro, you need to perform the following steps:

1. Jump up before activating the macro.

2. Adjust the values in the macro to your needs, taking into account ping and fps. The key value is the delay after the second click of the LMB, which will be individual for each player. The lower the ping and fps, the lower this value.

Approximate delay values for different fps values:
- 120 fps: start from 240 ms
- 90 fps: about 310 ms
- 60 fps: about 380ms

These values are approximate and depend on the ping. If the value could not be found, you can use the following method:

- Watch the execution of the second attack and the animation of the dash forward.
- If the character does not start the second attack and the animation breaks, then the delay needs to be increased.
- If the character makes two attacks and cancels the animation, but does not make a leap forward, the delay should be gradually increased.
- If the character makes two attacks and a dash, but does not push forward, the delay should be reduced.

If there is a multiple delay value (for example, 255, 270, 300, 405, etc.) and the animation is running, you can start fine-tuning the macro. To do this, iterate over the values in the range from (your value is 5) to (your value is + 5) in 1 ms increments. This way you will achieve maximum accuracy and stable operation of the macro.

3. To cancel the flight, you can use a Dodge or a glider. The jump will not work to cancel the flight.

Please note that setting up a macro may take some time and patience. This is important for achieving the best results and correct operation of the macro.

title: Spood
description:
Autouse flask is a macro in the Keyran program that allows you to automatically use flasks in the Trove game. Flasks in Trove are special items that give various bonuses, such as restoring health or energy. However, to use the flask, you need to press a certain key every time, which can be inconvenient and distract from the game.

The Autouse flask works as follows: after activating the macro, it will monitor the status of your character and automatically use the flask when your health or energy reaches a certain threshold. For example, if your health drops below 50%, the macro will automatically use the flask to restore health.

This is very convenient, as it will protect you from accidental death or lack of energy during intense gameplay. You will be able to focus on the game without being distracted by the use of flasks.

To use the autoflash, you need to install the Keyran program, open it and create a new macro. Then, inside the macro, you can specify the conditions for using flasks, such as the minimum threshold of health or energy. After that, save the macro and activate it.

Now, during the game, the macro will automatically monitor your condition and use flasks if necessary. This will greatly simplify and speed up your gameplay in Trove!

Example of using a macro:

1. Install the Keyran program on your computer and run it.
2. Create a new macro and name it «Autouse flask».
3. Inside the macro, add conditions for using flasks. For example:
- If health is below 50%, use a health recovery flask.
   - If the energy is below 25%, use an energy recovery flask.
4. Save the macro and activate it.
5. Start playing Trove and enjoy the automatic use of flasks!

Now you can enjoy the game Trove without being distracted by the use of flasks. Avtoyuz Flask will take care of your health and energy, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the gameplay!

Be sure to make sure that your friend eats before the process, otherwise you will severely injure him during the attacks.

2. A friend can be in AFK mode or engage in other non-PvP skills, such as developing their running skills. In this mode, you can attack him. It is important that you have PvP enabled and your partner has it disabled.

title: spam_1_chat
description:
Greetings, dear Keyran user!

I want to share with you my unique macro for the game Warface, which will disable anti-cheat. Follow my instructions to find out how it works:

1. First download the virtual machine and install Warface on it.
2. Log in to your account in the game from which you want to launch the game without anti-cheat.
3. Go to the chat with any of your friends (the friend must be offline) and activate the macro. After activation, you will see that the macro will start spamming into a chat with a friend with the text «1» and automatically send messages. This will happen at a tremendous speed, which will cause the game to freeze. Keep the macro active for 20 seconds.
4. After that, disable the macro and go to the main computer in the game center. Now we need the ProcessHacker program (you can use an alternative, the main thing is that it allows you to view the arguments for starting the game). Start the game and immediately suspend the process in ProcessHacker. Then open the process properties and find the startup arguments - <command line>;. Open the command prompt and enter these arguments.
5. Now stop the processes of the game center and the game. Press «Enter» on the command line and instantly switch to the virtual machine to continue spamming messages to a friend. Keep doing this until the game starts on the main computer. As soon as the game starts, keep the macro active for 15-30 seconds, and then you can turn off the virtual machine and the macro.
6. As a result, you will get a running game without anti-cheat.

I hope these instructions will help you enjoy the game Warface without the limitations of anti-cheat. Good luck and have a nice game!

description:
One of the most common keyboard shortcuts in the Warface game is a shot, followed by taking a prone position. But I know a simple way to solve this problem.

In the game settings, in the control menu, you need to change the purpose of the key responsible for changing the position of the game character to the «up» or «down» button, which are located on the mouse. To do this, you can use the macro editor and change the assigned key to the «Up» button in advance. If you prefer, then the «Click on the wheel» button can also be used.

If everything is set up correctly, then when the character is shot, he will instantly assume a prone position. But do not limit your imagination to this team only. After all, instead of the «lie down» command, you can also configure the macro to perform other actions, for example, jump to the right or left. title: WOrDoffWarc
description:
The macro settings for the hunter in the World of Warcraft game can significantly affect your pet's performance and protection. Let's start with attacking abilities. The following macros can be used to strengthen the pet's blows:

/zakl Tearing shot
/petattack

You can apply similar macros to each attacking ability of the pet. Before that, it is recommended to compare their effectiveness when used on a mannequin.

The following macros will also be useful for protection:

/ zakl Liveliness
/ zakl Survives the strongest (pet command)
/ zakl Roar of sacrifice (Pvp talent)
/use the health stone

These macros will allow you to quickly use the protective abilities that decorate your pet. Don't forget to include the Health stone in the list of your addons.

If you want your pet to heal you, use the following macro:

/cast [target=player] spiritual healing (exotic ability)

This will allow you to get the heal from the pet on yourself.

In addition, you have the option to use the following macros to stop the fight:

/petpassive
/zakl pretend to be dead
/zakl camouflage

This will help you quickly remove the agro from yourself and escape from enemies.

For more convenient use of macros, I recommend installing the TellMeWhen addon. It allows you to customize the display of stacks of a bursting shot and buffs of a beast strike. This way, you can easily track the required number of stacks and keep them in perfect condition.

You can also install the Range Display addon, which will help you control the distance to your opponents.

If you need more information about the hunter, I recommend watching the video on YouTube hunter from A to Z. There you will find useful tips and explanations for beginners.

Ultimately, setting up macros for the hunter plays an important role, especially with advanced gaming. Be sure to take the time and attention to properly adapt macros for a better experience in the game.
